   248→    )
   249→    next_nudges_mod.render_single_item_resolution_hint(items)
   250→    if show_plan_context:
   251→        next_nudges_mod.render_uncommitted_reminder(plan_data)
   252→        next_nudges_mod.render_followup_nudges(
   253→            state,
   254→            dim_scores,
   255→            issues_scoped,
   256→            strict_score=strict_score,
   257→            target_strict_score=target_strict,
   258→            queue_total=queue_total,
   259→            plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   260→            breakdown=breakdown,
   261→        )
   262→    print()
   263→
   264→    if items and plan_data and show_execution_prompt:
   265→        print_user_message(
   266→            "Start working on the task above. When done:"
   267→            " `desloppify plan resolve`. Full queue:"
   268→            " `desloppify plan show`."
   269→        )
   270→
   271→
   272→def _plan_data_for_view(plan: dict, *, show_plan_context: bool) -> dict | None:
   273→    if not show_plan_context:
   274→        return None
   275→    if plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("overrides") or plan.get("clusters"):
   276→        return plan
   277→    return None
   278→
   279→
   280→def _resolve_queue_items(
   281→    *,
   282→    state: dict,
   283→    config: dict,
   284→    opts: NextOptions,
   285→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   286→    target_strict: float,
   287→    build_work_queue_fn,
   288→) -> tuple[object, dict, list[dict], str | None]:
   289→    ctx = queue_context(
   290→        state,
   291→        target_strict=target_strict,
   292→        config=config,
   293→        plan=plan_for_queue,
   294→    )
   295→    effective_cluster = _resolve_cluster_focus(
   296→        plan_for_queue,
   297→        cluster_arg=opts.cluster,
   298→        scope=opts.scope,
   299→    )
   300→    queue = build_work_queue_fn(
   301→        state,
   302→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   303→            count=None,
   304→            scope=opts.scope,
   305→            status=opts.status,
   306→            include_subjective=True,
   307→            subjective_threshold=target_strict,
   308→            explain=opts.explain,
   309→            include_skipped=opts.include_skipped,
   310→            context=ctx,
   311→        ),
   312→    )
   313→    return ctx, queue, queue.get("items", []), effective_cluster
   314→
   315→
   316→def _apply_queue_view_transforms(
   317→    *,
   318→    items: list[dict],
   319→    queue: dict,
   320→    opts: NextOptions,
   321→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   322→    effective_cluster: str | None,
   323→    collapse_plan_clusters: bool,
   324→) -> list[dict]:
   325→    visible = items
   326→    if collapse_plan_clusters and effective_cluster and plan_for_queue:
   327→        visible = filter_cluster_focus(visible, plan_for_queue, effective_cluster)
   328→    elif (
   329→        collapse_plan_clusters
   330→        and plan_for_queue
   331→        and not effective_cluster
   332→        and not plan_for_queue.get("active_cluster")
   333→    ):
   334→        visible = collapse_clusters(visible, plan_for_queue)
   335→
   336→    if opts.count:
   337→        visible = visible[: opts.count]
   338→        queue["items"] = visible
   339→        queue["total"] = len(visible)
   340→    return visible
   341→
   342→
   343→def _render_non_empty_queue(
   344→    *,
   345→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   346→    state: dict,
   347→    items: list[dict],
   348→    queue: dict,
   349→    plan_data: dict | None,
   350→    guardrail_warnings: list[str],
   351→    write_query_fn,
   352→    view: QueueViewConfig,
   353→    opts: NextOptions,
   354→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   355→    effective_cluster: str | None,
   356→    target_strict: float,
   357→    ctx,
   358→    resolve_lang_fn,
   359→) -> None:
   360→    lang = resolve_lang_fn(args)
   361→    lang_name = lang.name if lang else None
   362→    narrative = compute_narrative(
   363→        state,
   364→        context=NarrativeContext(lang=lang_name, command=view.command_name, plan=plan_data),
   365→    )
   366→    payload = _write_next_payload(
   367→        queue=queue,
   368→        items=items,
   369→        state=state,
   370→        narrative=narrative,
   371→        plan_data=plan_data,
   372→        guardrail_warnings=guardrail_warnings,
   373→        write_query_fn=write_query_fn,
   374→        command_name=view.command_name,
   375→    )
   376→
   377→    if _emit_requested_output(opts, payload, items, command_name=view.command_name):
   378→        return
   379→
   380→    _render_terminal_queue_view(
   381→        queue=queue,
   382→        items=items,
   383→        state=state,
   384→        opts=opts,
   385→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   386→        plan_data=plan_data,
   387→        effective_cluster=effective_cluster,
   388→        target_strict=target_strict,
   389→        ctx=ctx,
   390→        show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context,
   391→        show_execution_prompt=view.show_execution_prompt,
   392→    )
   393→
   394→
   395→def _build_and_render_queue_view(
   396→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   397→    state: dict,
   398→    config: dict,
   399→    *,
   400→    deps: QueueRenderDeps,
   401→    view: QueueViewConfig,
   402→) -> None:
   403→    """Build queue payload and render output for a queue surface."""
   404→    opts = NextOptions.from_args(args)
   405→    guardrail_warnings = triage_guardrail_messages(state=state)
   406→    target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(config)
   407→
   408→    plan = deps.load_plan_fn()
   409→    plan_for_queue = plan
   410→    plan_data = _plan_data_for_view(plan, show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context)
   411→    ctx, queue, items, effective_cluster = _resolve_queue_items(
   412→        state=state,
   413→        config=config,
   414→        opts=opts,
   415→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   416→        target_strict=target_strict,
   417→        build_work_queue_fn=deps.build_work_queue_fn,
   418→    )
   419→    items = _apply_queue_view_transforms(
   420→        items=items,
   421→        queue=queue,
   422→        opts=opts,
   423→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   424→        effective_cluster=effective_cluster,
   425→        collapse_plan_clusters=view.collapse_plan_clusters,
   426→    )
   427→
   428→    if not items:
   429→        _render_empty_queue_view(
   430→            queue=queue,
   431→            items=items,
   432→            state=state,
   433→            plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   434→            plan_data=plan_data,
   435→            ctx=ctx,
   436→            target_strict=target_strict,
   437→            opts=opts,
   438→            guardrail_warnings=guardrail_warnings,
   439→            write_query_fn=deps.write_query_fn,
   440→            command_name=view.command_name,
   441→            show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context,
   442→        )
   443→        return
   444→
   445→    _render_non_empty_queue(
   446→        args=args,
   447→        state=state,
   448→        items=items,
   449→        queue=queue,
   450→        plan_data=plan_data,
   451→        guardrail_warnings=guardrail_warnings,
   452→        write_query_fn=deps.write_query_fn,
   453→        view=view,
   454→        opts=opts,
   455→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   456→        effective_cluster=effective_cluster,
   457→        target_strict=target_strict,
   458→        ctx=ctx,
   459→        resolve_lang_fn=deps.resolve_lang_fn,
   460→    )
   461→
   462→
   463→def build_and_render_execution_queue(
   464→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   465→    state: dict,
   466→    config: dict,
   467→    *,
   468→    deps: QueueRenderDeps | None = None,
   469→) -> None:
   470→    """Build queue payload and render output for `desloppify next`."""
   471→    build_and_render_queue(
   472→        args,
   473→        state,
   474→        config,
   475→        view=EXECUTION_QUEUE_VIEW,
   476→        deps=deps
   477→        or QueueRenderDeps(
   478→            build_work_queue_fn=build_execution_queue,
   479→        ),
   480→    )
   481→
   482→
   483→def build_and_render_backlog_queue(
   484→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   485→    state: dict,
   486→    config: dict,
   487→    *,
   488→    deps: QueueRenderDeps | None = None,
   489→) -> None:
   490→    """Build queue payload and render output for `desloppify backlog`."""
   491→    build_and_render_queue(
   492→        args,
   493→        state,
   494→        config,
   495→        view=BACKLOG_QUEUE_VIEW,
   496→        deps=deps
   497→        or QueueRenderDeps(
   498→            build_work_queue_fn=build_backlog_queue,
   499→        ),
   500→    )
   501→
   502→
   503→def build_and_render_queue(
   504→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   505→    state: dict,
   506→    config: dict,
   507→    *,
   508→    view: QueueViewConfig = EXECUTION_QUEUE_VIEW,
   509→    deps: QueueRenderDeps | None = None,

   312→    objective_backlog_count = sum(
   313→        1 for item in planned_objective_items if item.get("id", "") not in execution_ids
   314→    )
   315→    has_unplanned_objective_blockers = len(planned_objective_items) < len(objective_items)
   316→
   317→    return QueueSnapshot(
   318→        phase=phase,
   319→        all_objective_items=tuple(objective_items),
   320→        all_initial_review_items=tuple(initial_review_items),
   321→        all_postflight_review_items=tuple(postflight_review_items),
   322→        all_scan_items=tuple(scan_items),
   323→        all_postflight_workflow_items=tuple(postflight_workflow_items),
   324→        all_postflight_triage_items=tuple(triage_items),
   325→        execution_items=tuple(execution_items),
   326→        backlog_items=tuple(backlog_items),
   327→        objective_in_scope_count=len(objective_items),
   328→        planned_objective_count=len(planned_objective_items),
   329→        objective_execution_count=sum(
   330→            1
   331→            for item in execution_items
   332→            if item.get("kind") in {"issue", "cluster"}
   333→            and item.get("detector", "") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   334→        ),
   335→        objective_backlog_count=objective_backlog_count,
   336→        subjective_initial_count=len(initial_review_items),
   337→        subjective_postflight_count=len(postflight_review_items),
   338→        workflow_postflight_count=len(postflight_workflow_items),
   339→        triage_pending_count=len(triage_items),
   340→        has_unplanned_objective_blockers=has_unplanned_objective_blockers,
   341→    )
   342→
   343→
   344→def coarse_phase_name(phase: str) -> str:
   345→    """Map internal queue phases to the persisted coarse lifecycle value."""
   346→    if phase == PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL or phase == PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT:
   347→        return "review"
   348→    if phase == PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT:
   349→        return "workflow"
   350→    if phase == PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT:
   351→        return "triage"
   352→    return phase
   353→

    12→
    13→def _normalized_issue_id_list(raw_ids: object) -> list[str]:
    14→    normalized: list[str] = []
    15→    seen: set[str] = set()
    16→    if not isinstance(raw_ids, list):
    17→        return normalized
    18→    for raw_id in raw_ids:
    19→        if not isinstance(raw_id, str):
    20→            continue
    21→        issue_id = raw_id.strip()
    22→        if not issue_id or issue_id in seen:
    23→            continue
    24→        seen.add(issue_id)
    25→        normalized.append(issue_id)
    26→    return normalized
    27→
    28→
    29→def _cluster_issue_ids(cluster: dict[str, object]) -> list[str]:
    30→    ordered: list[str] = []
    31→    seen: set[str] = set()
    32→
    33→    def _append(raw_ids: object) -> None:
    34→        if not isinstance(raw_ids, list):
    35→            return
    36→        for raw_id in raw_ids:
    37→            if not isinstance(raw_id, str):
    38→                continue
    39→            issue_id = raw_id.strip()
    40→            if not issue_id or issue_id in seen:
    41→                continue
    42→            seen.add(issue_id)
    43→            ordered.append(issue_id)
    44→
    45→    _append(cluster.get("issue_ids"))
    46→    steps = cluster.get("action_steps")
    47→    if isinstance(steps, list):
    48→        for step in steps:
    49→            if not isinstance(step, dict):
    50→                continue
    51→            _append(step.get("issue_refs"))
    52→    return ordered
    53→
    54→
    55→def plan_review_ids(plan: dict) -> list[str]:
    56→    """Return review/concerns IDs currently represented in queue_order."""
    57→    return [
    58→        issue_id
    59→        for issue_id in plan.get("queue_order", [])
    60→        if isinstance(issue_id, str)
    61→        and not issue_id.startswith("triage::")
    62→        and not issue_id.startswith("workflow::")
    63→        and (issue_id.startswith("review::") or issue_id.startswith("concerns::"))
    64→    ]
    65→
    66→
    67→def coverage_open_ids(plan: dict, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    68→    """Return the frozen or live open review IDs covered by this triage run."""
    69→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
    70→    active_ids = _normalized_issue_id_list(meta.get("active_triage_issue_ids"))
    71→    if active_ids:
    72→        return set(active_ids)
    73→    has_completed_scan = bool(state.get("last_scan"))
    74→    review_ids = open_review_ids(state)
    75→    if not has_completed_scan and not review_ids:
    76→        return set(plan_review_ids(plan))
    77→    return review_ids
    78→
    79→
    80→def active_triage_issue_ids(plan: dict, state: StateModel | None = None) -> set[str]:
    81→    """Return the frozen review issue set for the current triage run."""
    82→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
    83→    active_ids = _normalized_issue_id_list(meta.get("active_triage_issue_ids"))
    84→    if active_ids:
    85→        return set(active_ids)
    86→    if state is None:
    87→        return set()
    88→    return coverage_open_ids(plan, state)
    89→
    90→
    91→def _explicit_active_triage_issue_ids(plan: dict) -> set[str]:
    92→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
    93→    return set(_normalized_issue_id_list(meta.get("active_triage_issue_ids")))
    94→
    95→
    96→def live_active_triage_issue_ids(plan: dict, state: StateModel | None = None) -> set[str]:
    97→    """Return frozen triage IDs that are still open review issues in state."""
    98→    frozen_ids = active_triage_issue_ids(plan, state)
    99→    if state is None or not frozen_ids:
   100→        return frozen_ids
   101→    return frozen_ids & open_review_ids(state)
   102→
   103→
   104→def undispositioned_triage_issue_ids(plan: dict, state: StateModel | None = None) -> list[str]:
   105→    """Return frozen triage issues still lacking cluster/skip/dismiss coverage."""
   106→    target_ids = live_active_triage_issue_ids(plan, state)
   107→    if not target_ids:
   108→        return []
   109→
   110→    covered_ids: set[str] = set()
   111→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   112→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict) or cluster.get("auto"):
   113→            continue
   114→        covered_ids.update(_cluster_issue_ids(cluster))
   115→
   116→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
   117→    if isinstance(skipped, dict):
   118→        covered_ids.update(
   119→            issue_id for issue_id in skipped if isinstance(issue_id, str)
   120→        )
   121→
   122→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   123→    covered_ids.update(_normalized_issue_id_list(meta.get("dismissed_ids")))
   124→
   125→    dispositions = meta.get("issue_dispositions", {})
   126→    if isinstance(dispositions, dict) and isinstance(skipped, dict):
   127→        for issue_id, disposition in dispositions.items():
   128→            if (
   129→                isinstance(issue_id, str)
   130→                and isinstance(disposition, dict)
   131→                and disposition.get("decision_source") == "observe_auto"
   132→                and issue_id in skipped
   133→            ):
   134→                covered_ids.add(issue_id)
   135→
   136→    return sorted(issue_id for issue_id in target_ids if issue_id not in covered_ids)
   137→
   138→
   139→def triage_coverage(
   140→    plan: dict,
   141→    open_review_ids: set[str] | None = None,
   142→) -> tuple[int, int, dict[str, dict]]:
   143→    """Return (organized, total, clusters) for review issues in triage."""
   144→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   145→    all_cluster_ids: set[str] = set()
   146→    for cluster in clusters.values():
   147→        if isinstance(cluster, dict):
   148→            all_cluster_ids.update(_cluster_issue_ids(cluster))
   149→    review_ids = list(open_review_ids) if open_review_ids is not None else plan_review_ids(plan)
   150→    organized = sum(1 for issue_id in review_ids if issue_id in all_cluster_ids)
   151→    return organized, len(review_ids), clusters
   152→
   153→
   154→def manual_clusters_with_issues(plan: dict) -> list[str]:
   155→    """Return manual clusters that currently own at least one issue."""
   156→    return [
   157→        name
   158→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   159→        if isinstance(cluster, dict) and _cluster_issue_ids(cluster) and not cluster.get("auto")
   160→    ]
   161→
   162→
   163→def find_cluster_for(issue_id: str, clusters: dict[str, dict]) -> str | None:
   164→    """Return the owning cluster name for an issue ID, if any."""
   165→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   166→        if isinstance(cluster, dict) and issue_id in _cluster_issue_ids(cluster):
   167→            return name
   168→    return None
   169→
   170→
   171→@dataclass(frozen=True)
   172→class TriageSnapshot:
   173→    """Single shared triage-status snapshot for command surfaces."""
   174→
   175→    progress: TriageProgress
   176→    frozen_issue_ids: frozenset[str]
   177→    live_open_ids: frozenset[str]
   178→    new_since_triage_ids: frozenset[str]
   179→    undispositioned_ids: frozenset[str]
   180→    organized_count: int
   181→    total_in_scope: int
   182→    has_triage_in_queue: bool
   183→    is_triage_stale: bool
   184→    cycle_active: bool
   185→    triage_has_run: bool
   186→
   187→
   188→def build_triage_snapshot(plan: dict, state: StateModel) -> TriageSnapshot:
   189→    """Build a canonical triage snapshot from plan and state."""
   190→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   191→    triaged_ids = set(_normalized_issue_id_list(meta.get("triaged_ids")))
   192→    frozen_ids = _explicit_active_triage_issue_ids(plan) & open_review_ids(state)
   193→    live_open = open_review_ids(state)
   194→    known_ids = triaged_ids | frozen_ids
   195→    new_since = live_open - known_ids if known_ids else set()
   196→    in_scope_ids = coverage_open_ids(plan, state)
   197→    organized_count, total_in_scope, _clusters = triage_coverage(
   198→        plan,
   199→        open_review_ids=in_scope_ids,
   200→    )
   201→
   202→    return TriageSnapshot(
   203→        progress=compute_triage_progress(meta.get("triage_stages", {})),
   204→        frozen_issue_ids=frozenset(frozen_ids),
   205→        live_open_ids=frozenset(live_open),
   206→        new_since_triage_ids=frozenset(new_since),
   207→        undispositioned_ids=frozenset(undispositioned_triage_issue_ids(plan, state)),
   208→        organized_count=organized_count,
   209→        total_in_scope=total_in_scope,
   210→        has_triage_in_queue=bool(set(plan.get("queue_order", [])) & TRIAGE_IDS),
   211→        is_triage_stale=bool(new_since),
   212→        cycle_active=bool(frozen_ids),
   213→        triage_has_run=bool(triaged_ids),
   214→    )
   215→

    19→def _subjective_threshold(state: StateModel, *, default: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE) -> float:
    20→    config = state.get("config", {})
    21→    raw_target = default
    22→    if isinstance(config, dict):
    23→        raw_target = config.get("target_strict_score", default)
    24→    try:
    25→        value = float(raw_target)
    26→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    27→        value = default
    28→    return max(0.0, min(100.0, value))

    30→
    31→def _queue_plan_from_options(options: QueueBuildOptions) -> dict | None:
    32→    if options.context is not None:
    33→        return options.context.plan
    34→    return options.plan

    36→
    37→def build_open_plan_queue(
    38→    state: StateModel,
    39→    *,
    40→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
    41→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    42→    """Build one open-status queue with consistent planning policy defaults."""
    43→    opts = replace(options) if options is not None else QueueBuildOptions(count=None)
    44→    if options is None:
    45→        opts = replace(opts, status="open", include_subjective=True)
    46→    elif opts.status == QueueBuildOptions().status:
    47→        opts = replace(opts, status="open")
    48→    if opts.subjective_threshold == QueueBuildOptions().subjective_threshold:
    49→        opts = replace(opts, subjective_threshold=_subjective_threshold(state))
    50→    return build_work_queue(
    51→        state,
    52→        options=opts,

    19→def build_work_queue(

    21→    *,

    23→) -> WorkQueueResult:

    32→def _build_work_queue_with_visibility(
    33→    state: StateModel,
    34→    *,
    35→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
    36→    visibility: str = QueueVisibility.ALL,
    37→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    38→    """Build a ranked work queue from canonical queue partitions.
    39→
    40→    Open-status queue views are resolved from the canonical queue snapshot so
    41→    lifecycle phase, execution visibility, and backlog visibility all come
    42→    from one source of truth. Non-open status views remain issue-list queries.
    43→    """

    48→        opts=opts,
    49→        plan=plan,
    50→        scan_path=scan_path,
    51→        status=status,
    52→        threshold=threshold,
    53→        visibility=visibility,
    54→    )
    55→    return finalize_queue(items, state=state, plan=plan, opts=opts)

     5→Callers build one context and pass it everywhere — makes the wrong thing

    50→def resolve_plan_load_status(
    51→    *,
    52→    plan: PlanOption = _PLAN_AUTO_LOAD,
    53→) -> PlanLoadStatus:
    54→    """Resolve plan loading and explicitly report degraded mode."""
    55→    if not isinstance(plan, _PlanAutoLoad):

    70→    except (

    20→def _clear_missing_cluster_override(
    21→    override: dict,
    22→    clusters: dict,
    23→    now: str,
    24→) -> int:
    25→    cluster_name = override.get("cluster")
    26→    if not cluster_name or cluster_name in clusters:
    27→        return 0
    28→    override["cluster"] = None
    29→    override["updated_at"] = now
    30→    return 1
    31→
    32→
    33→def _canonical_cluster_membership(clusters: dict) -> dict[str, str]:
    34→    canonical: dict[str, str] = {}
    35→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
    36→        for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
    37→            if issue_id not in canonical or not cluster.get("auto"):
    38→                canonical[issue_id] = name
    39→    return canonical
    40→
    41→
    42→def _sync_override_to_canonical_cluster(
    43→    issue_id: str,
    44→    cluster_name: str,
    45→    overrides: dict,
    46→    now: str,
    47→) -> int:
    48→    override = overrides.get(issue_id)
    49→    if override is None:
    50→        overrides[issue_id] = {
    51→            "issue_id": issue_id,
    52→            "cluster": cluster_name,
    53→            "created_at": now,
    54→            "updated_at": now,
    55→        }
    56→        return 1
    57→    if override.get("cluster") == cluster_name:
    58→        return 0
    59→    override["cluster"] = cluster_name
    60→    override["updated_at"] = now
    61→    return 1
    62→
    63→
    64→def _clear_stale_override_cluster_refs(
    65→    overrides: dict,
    66→    clusters: dict,
    67→    canonical: dict[str, str],
    68→    now: str,
    69→) -> int:
    70→    repaired = 0
    71→    for issue_id, override in overrides.items():
    72→        ref = override.get("cluster")
    73→        if not ref or ref not in clusters or issue_id in canonical:
    74→            continue
    75→        override["cluster"] = None
    76→        override["updated_at"] = now
    77→        repaired += 1
    78→    return repaired

    80→
    81→def _repair_ghost_cluster_refs(plan: PlanModel, now: str) -> int:
    82→    """Cross-check cluster membership between cluster.issue_ids and overrides.
    83→
    84→    Repairs three kinds of drift:
    85→    1. Override points to a cluster that does not exist → clear override.
    86→    2. Override points to cluster X, but issue is not in X's issue_ids → add it.
    87→    3. Issue is in cluster.issue_ids but override points elsewhere (or has no
    88→       cluster ref) → update override to match cluster.issue_ids.
    89→
    90→    cluster.issue_ids is treated as authoritative when it disagrees with
    91→    the override, because the sync helpers always write issue_ids first.
    92→    """
    93→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    94→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
    95→    repaired = 0
    96→
    97→    for override in overrides.values():
    98→        repaired += _clear_missing_cluster_override(override, clusters, now)
    99→
   100→    canonical = _canonical_cluster_membership(clusters)

    21→def cmd_autofix(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    22→    """Auto-fix mechanical issues."""

    24→
    25→    dry_run = getattr(args, "dry_run", False)
    26→    path = Path(args.path)
    27→

    35→        return
    36→
    37→    raw = fixer.fix(entries, dry_run=dry_run)
    38→    results = raw.entries
    39→    skip_reasons = raw.skip_reasons
    40→    total_items = sum(len(r["removed"]) for r in results)
    41→    total_lines = sum(r.get("lines_removed", 0) for r in results)
    42→    _print_fix_summary(fixer, results, total_items, total_lines, dry_run)
    43→
    44→    if dry_run and results:

    46→
    47→    if not dry_run:

    57→            skip_reasons,
    58→        )
    59→    else:

    61→    print()

    28→    if fixer_name in _COMMAND_POST_FIX and not fixer_config.post_fix:
    29→        fixer_config = dataclasses.replace(
    30→            fixer_config,
    31→            post_fix=_COMMAND_POST_FIX[fixer_name],

    33→    return lang, fixer_config

    40→def last_real_review_timestamp(state: dict) -> str | None:
    41→    """ISO timestamp of most recent genuine review import (not manual override/scan reset)."""
    42→    real_modes = {"holistic", "per_file", "trusted_internal", "attested_external"}
    43→    audit = state.get("assessment_import_audit", [])
    44→    if isinstance(audit, list):
    45→        for entry in reversed(audit):
    46→            if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("mode") in real_modes:
    47→                ts = entry.get("timestamp")
    48→                if ts:
    49→                    return str(ts)
    50→    holistic = (state.get("review_cache") or {}).get("holistic")
    51→    if isinstance(holistic, dict):

    53→    return None

    56→def detect_recurring_patterns(
    57→    open_issues: dict[str, dict],
    58→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
    59→) -> dict[str, dict]:
    60→    """Detect dimensions with both resolved AND current open issues.
    61→
    62→    Returns ``{dimension: {"open": [ids], "resolved": [ids]}}``.
    63→    A dimension with both resolved and open issues signals a potential
    64→    loop — similar issues recur after previous fixes.
    65→    """
    66→
    67→    def _dimension(finding: dict) -> str:
    68→        detail = finding.get("detail", {})
    69→        if isinstance(detail, dict):
    70→            return detail.get("dimension", "")
    71→        return ""
    72→
    73→    open_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    74→    for fid, finding in open_issues.items():
    75→        dim = _dimension(finding)
    76→        if dim:
    77→            open_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
    78→
    79→    resolved_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    80→    for fid, finding in resolved_issues.items():
    81→        dim = _dimension(finding)
    82→        if dim:
    83→            resolved_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
    84→
    85→    recurring: dict[str, dict] = {}
    86→    for dim in set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim):
    87→        recurring[dim] = {
    88→            "open": open_by_dim[dim],
    89→            "resolved": resolved_by_dim[dim],
    90→        }
    91→    return recurring

    10→
    11→def detect_phase(history: list[dict], strict_score: float | None) -> str:
    12→    """Detect project phase from scan history trajectory."""
    13→    if not history:
    14→        return "first_scan"
    15→
    16→    if len(history) == 1:
    17→        return "first_scan"
    18→
    19→    strict = strict_score
    20→    if strict is None:
    21→        strict = _history_strict(history[-1])
    22→
    23→    # Check regression: strict dropped from previous scan
    24→    prev = _history_strict(history[-2])
    25→    curr = _history_strict(history[-1])
    26→    if prev is not None and curr is not None and curr < prev - 0.5:
    27→        return "regression"
    28→
    29→    # Check stagnation: strict unchanged ±0.5 for 3+ scans
    30→    if len(history) >= 3:
    31→        recent = [_history_strict(h) for h in history[-3:]]
    32→        if all(r is not None for r in recent):
    33→            spread = max(recent) - min(recent)
    34→            if spread <= 0.5:
    35→                return "stagnation"
    36→
    37→    # Early momentum: scans 2-5 with score rising — check BEFORE score thresholds
    38→    # so early projects get motivational framing even if score is already high
    39→    if len(history) <= 5:
    40→        first = _history_strict(history[0])
    41→        last = _history_strict(history[-1])
    42→        if first is not None and last is not None and last > first:
    43→            return "early_momentum"
    44→
    45→    if strict is not None:
    46→        if strict > 93:
    47→            return "maintenance"
    48→        if strict > 80:
    49→            return "refinement"
    50→
    51→    return "middle_grind"
    52→

     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from typing import Any

    11→
    12→
    13→def _move_reasons(by_detector: dict[str, int]) -> list[str]:
    14→    reasons: list[str] = []
    15→    if by_detector.get("orphaned", 0):
    16→        reasons.append(f"{by_detector['orphaned']} orphaned files")
    17→    if by_detector.get("coupling", 0):
    18→        reasons.append(f"{by_detector['coupling']} coupling violations")
    19→    if by_detector.get("single_use", 0):
    20→        reasons.append(f"{by_detector['single_use']} single-use files")
    21→    if by_detector.get("flat_dirs", 0):
    22→        reasons.append(f"{by_detector['flat_dirs']} flat directories")
    23→    if by_detector.get("naming", 0):
    24→        reasons.append(f"{by_detector['naming']} naming issues")
    25→    return reasons
    26→
    27→
    28→def _build_fixers(
    29→    by_detector: dict[str, int], state: StateModel, lang: str | None
    30→) -> list[ToolFixer]:
    31→    fixers: list[ToolFixer] = []
    32→    supported = supported_fixers(state, lang)
    33→
    34→    for detector, tool_info in DETECTOR_TOOLS.items():
    35→        if tool_info["action_type"] != "auto_fix":
    36→            continue
    37→        count = by_detector.get(detector, 0)
    38→        if count == 0:
    39→            continue
    40→
    41→        for fixer in tool_info["fixers"]:
    42→            if supported is not None and fixer not in supported:
    43→                continue
    44→            fixers.append(
    45→                {
    46→                    "name": fixer,
    47→                    "detector": detector,
    48→                    "open_count": count,
    49→                    "command": f"desloppify autofix {fixer} --dry-run",
    50→                }
    51→            )
    52→
    53→    return fixers
    54→
    55→
    56→def compute_tools(
    57→    by_detector: dict[str, int],
    58→    state: StateModel,
    59→    lang: str | None,
    60→    badge: dict[str, Any],
    61→) -> ToolInventory:
    62→    move_keys = ["orphaned", "flat_dirs", "naming", "single_use", "coupling", "cycles"]
    63→    organizational_issues = sum(by_detector.get(detector, 0) for detector in move_keys)
    64→    reasons = _move_reasons(by_detector)
    65→
    66→    return {
    67→        "fixers": _build_fixers(by_detector, state, lang),
    68→        "move": {
    69→            "available": True,
    70→            "relevant": organizational_issues > 0,
    71→            "reason": " + ".join(reasons) if reasons else None,
    72→            "usage": "desloppify move <source> <dest> [--dry-run]",
    73→        },
    74→        "plan": {
    75→            "command": "desloppify plan",
    76→            "description": "Generate prioritized markdown cleanup plan",
    77→        },
    78→        "badge": badge,
    79→    }
    80→

def filter_cluster_focus(
    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
    plan: dict,
    cluster: str | None,
) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
    """Filter to only cluster members when a cluster focus is active."""
    effective_cluster = cluster or plan.get("active_cluster")
    if not effective_cluster:
        return items
    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
    cluster_member_ids = set(_cluster_issue_ids(cluster_data))
    if not cluster_member_ids:
        return items

def collapse_clusters(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.

    Both auto-clusters and manual (triage) clusters are collapsed.  Manual
    clusters are inserted at the front in plan order so triage-prioritised
    work appears before auto-clustered mechanical items.
    """
    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    if not clusters:
        return items

    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
        for issue_id in _cluster_issue_ids(cluster):
            # Manual clusters take priority when an issue is in both
            if issue_id not in fid_to_cluster or not cluster.get("auto"):
                fid_to_cluster[issue_id] = name

    if not fid_to_cluster:
        return items

   208→

   210→    clusters are inserted at the front in plan order so triage-prioritised
   211→    work appears before auto-clustered mechanical items.
   212→    """

   240→            cname, members, clusters.get(cname, {})

   243→    # Collect manual cluster names in plan order (for front-insertion)
   244→    manual_names = [

   246→        if not clusters[name].get("auto") and name in meta_items

   250→    # skip subsequent members.  Manual cluster members are always skipped
   251→    # (they'll be inserted at the front).
   252→    seen_clusters: set[str] = set()
   253→    rest: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   254→    for item in items:

   261→                    rest.append(meta_items[cname])

   263→        else:
   264→            rest.append(item)

   267→    manual_result = [meta_items[name] for name in manual_names if name in seen_clusters]

## Summary: Queue, Snapshot, Next Command, Backlog, Phase Selection & Autofix Logic

Based on my comprehensive search through the desloppify codebase, here's how these interconnected systems work:

---

### 1. **NEXT COMMAND - How it Determines What to Show**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/next/cmd.py`
- **`cmd_next()`** — Entry point that loads state/config, validates issue inventory, and delegates to `build_and_render_queue()`
- Calls `build_execution_queue()` to get the canonical queue filtered for visible, executable items
- Renders via narrative coaching + terminal output

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/next/queue_flow.py`
- **`build_and_render_queue()`** — Main orchestrator that coordinates:
  1. Loads plan + state + config
  2. Builds queue context via `queue_context()`
  3. Resolves queue items via `_resolve_queue_items()`
  4. Applies transforms (cluster collapse/focus filtering)
  5. Renders output (terminal or JSON)
- **`_resolve_queue_items()`** — Calls `build_execution_queue()` with `QueueBuildOptions`, returns context + queue + items
- **`_apply_queue_view_transforms()`** — Applies `collapse_clusters()` or `filter_cluster_focus()` to transform items based on plan state
- **`_plan_data_for_view()`** — Returns plan data only if `show_plan_context=True` (execution queue does this; backlog doesn't)

---

### 2. **SNAPSHOT LOGIC - Building the Execution Snapshot**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/snapshot.py`
- **`build_queue_snapshot()`** — Canonical snapshot computation that partitions ALL items by phase/visibility:
  - Resolves plan from options or explicit parameter
  - Builds all issue items, filters objective vs. subjective, objective vs. backlog
  - Partitions into 7 item lists: objective, initial_review, postflight_review, scan, postflight_workflow, triage_postflight, subjective
  - Computes canonical `phase` (which phase is "executable now")
  - Derives `execution_items` (items to show right now) and `backlog_items` (deferred work)
  - Returns **`QueueSnapshot`** dataclass with phase, all_*_items, execution_items, backlog_items, counts

**Key Logic**:
- **`_phase_for_snapshot()`** — Determines execution phase by checking which work pools have items:
  1. Fresh boundary + initial review items → `PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL`
  2. Objective items available → `PHASE_EXECUTE`
  3. Scan items available → `PHASE_SCAN`
  4. Postflight review items → `PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT`
  5. Postflight workflow items → `PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT`
  6. Triage items → `PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT`

- **`_execution_items_for_phase()`** — Extracts the executable pool for the current phase (NOT all items)
- **`_is_fresh_boundary()`** — Checks if plan has `reset=True` in `plan_start_scores` to detect cycle starts

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/state_score_snapshot.py`
- **`ScoreSnapshot`** and **`score_snapshot()`** — Lightweight wrapper around state scoring for overall/objective/strict/verified scores

---

### 3. **QUEUE_ORDER & "EXECUTABLE" - What Gets Treated as Executable**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/schema/__init__.py`

**PlanModel TypedDict** fields:
- **`queue_order: list[str]`** — Ordered list of issue/cluster IDs the user has prioritized (living plan)
- **`skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry]`** — Issues marked temporary/permanent/false-positive (excluded from execution)
- **`overrides: dict[str, ItemOverride]`** — Per-issue descriptions, notes, cluster assignments
- **`clusters: dict[str, Cluster]`** — Auto and manual clusters with issue_ids, action_steps, priority
- **`active_cluster: str | None`** — Current cluster user is focused on (filters execution to cluster members)

**Executability Logic**:
1. Objective items are "executable" if they're in `queue_order` AND not in `skipped`
2. Subjective items are "initial executable" only at fresh boundaries OR at postflight phase
3. Review items hidden until triage is current (`build_triage_snapshot()` checks staleness)
4. **`planned_objective_ids()`** — Returns the intersection of all objective issues with tracked plan IDs

---

### 4. **PHASE_EXECUTE - Entering the Execute Phase**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/snapshot.py` (lines 174-187)

**Transition Rules**:
1. If fresh boundary AND initial review items exist → `PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL` (review new findings first)
2. Else if objective items (planned work) available → **`PHASE_EXECUTE`** (do the work)
3. Else if scan items available → `PHASE_SCAN`
4. Else if postflight review → `PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT`
5. Else if postflight workflow → `PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT`
6. Else if triage pending → `PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT`

**PHASE_EXECUTE becomes active when**:
- Plan has tracked objective issues in `queue_order` AND
- Plan is NOT at a fresh boundary OR initial review items are empty AND
- User hasn't marked them all as skipped

---

### 5. **AUTOFIX CLUSTERS - How They're Built and Surfaced**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/auto_cluster.py`
- **`sync_issue_clusters()`** (imported from `auto_cluster_sync`) — Regenerates auto-clusters from issues based on `cluster_key` (deterministic grouping)
- Auto clusters marked with `auto: True` in the Cluster schema

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/plan_order.py` (lines 206-268)
- **`collapse_clusters()`** — Transforms individual cluster members into single cluster meta-items:
  1. Maps issue_id → cluster_name (manual clusters take priority over auto)
  2. Builds cluster meta-items only for clusters with 2+ members visible in queue
  3. **Manual clusters inserted at front** (triage-prioritized work first)
  4. **Auto-clusters collapse in-place** (replace first member with meta-item, skip rest)
  5. Returns collapsed list: `[manual_cluster_metas...] + [auto_cluster_metas + non_clustered_items]`

- **`_build_cluster_meta()`** (lines 152-203) — Constructs cluster meta-item with:
  - **`autofix_hint`** — Set if cluster action contains `"desloppify autofix"` (e.g., action: `"desloppify autofix import-cleanup"`)
  - **`action_type`** — Inferred: `"auto_fix"` if action references autofix, else `"refactor"` or `"reorganize"` or detector-based
  - **`primary_command`** — User-provided action or default `"desloppify next --cluster {name} --count 10"`
  - **`members`** — List of individual issues in cluster
  - **`cluster_auto`** — Boolean flag indicating auto vs. manual

---

### 6. **TRIAGE ↔ QUEUE INTERACTION**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/triage/snapshot.py`
- **`build_triage_snapshot()`** — Computes triage coverage + staleness:
  - `frozen_issue_ids` — Issues triage was run against (locked for this cycle)
  - `live_open_ids` — Current open review issues in state
  - `new_since_triage_ids` — Issues created after triage (signals staleness)
  - `has_triage_in_queue` — Whether triage itself is in `queue_order`
  - `is_triage_stale` — True if new_since != empty (new issues discovered)
  - `triage_has_run` — True if `triaged_ids` is non-empty

- **`_executable_review_issue_items()`** — Review items hidden from execution unless:
  1. No triage in queue AND
  2. Triage is NOT stale AND
  3. Triage has previously run

**Triage field in plan**: `epic_triage_meta: EpicTriageMeta` — Stores:
  - `active_triage_issue_ids` — Frozen set of issues covered by current triage run
  - `triaged_ids` — IDs already processed by triage (historical)
  - `issue_dispositions` — Per-issue verdict (genuine/false-positive) + decision (cluster/skip)
  - `triage_stages` — Checkpoints for observe/reflect stages

### 7. **BACKLOG - Current Definition and Surfacing**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/backlog/cmd.py`
- **`cmd_backlog()`** — Shows backlog items via `build_and_render_queue()` with:
  - `view=BACKLOG_QUEUE_VIEW` — Sets `show_plan_context=False`, `collapse_plan_clusters=False`
  - Calls `build_backlog_queue()` which uses `QueueVisibility.BACKLOG`

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/planning/queue_policy.py`
- **`build_backlog_queue()`** — Builds the broader backlog by:
  1. Creating queue context with plan + target_strict
  2. Calling `_build_work_queue_with_visibility(..., visibility=QueueVisibility.BACKLOG)`

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_work_queue/selection.py`
- **`select_queue_items()`** with `visibility=QueueVisibility.BACKLOG` → calls `items_for_visibility(snapshot, "backlog")`
- **`items_for_visibility()`** returns `snapshot.backlog_items` (all items NOT currently executable)

**Backlog = All tracked/open issues EXCEPT those in execution_items**:
- Backlog includes: planned objective items not yet in execution phase, subjective items deferred, review items not executable, workflow/triage items queued but not active

This interconnected system ensures that at any moment:
1. The **snapshot** partitions work by phase (review → execute → scan → postflight)
2. **Next** shows only the current phase's items, collapsed into clusters where applicable
3. **Backlog** shows deferred work (everything outside execution phase)
4. **Triage** gates review items and controls cluster formation
5. **Autofix** suggestions are surfaced via cluster actions + narrative recommendations
6. **Queue order + active cluster** filter execution to planned/focused work

    84→    Repairs three kinds of drift:

    86→    2. Override points to cluster X, but issue is not in X's issue_ids → add it.
    87→    3. Issue is in cluster.issue_ids but override points elsewhere (or has no
    88→       cluster ref) → update override to match cluster.issue_ids.

   136→    changes += _sync_subjective_clusters(
   137→        plan, state, issues, clusters, existing_by_key, active_auto_keys, now,
   138→        target_strict=target_strict,

   152→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   153→) -> int:
   154→    """Regenerate auto-clusters from current open issues.
   155→

   157→    """

1→"""Internal sync helpers for auto-cluster regeneration.
     2→
     3→Creates and updates auto-clusters from current queue state.  Does NOT
     4→manage queue membership — ``sync_subjective_dimensions`` is the sole authority
     5→on which subjective IDs belong in ``queue_order``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass

    12→from desloppify.engine._plan.policy import stale as stale_policy_mod
    13→from desloppify.engine._plan.sync.context import (

    21→from desloppify.engine._plan.policy.subjective import SubjectiveVisibility

    24→    current_under_target_ids,
    25→    current_unscored_ids,
    26→)
    27→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    28→
    29→_MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE = 2
    30→_STALE_KEY = "subjective::stale"
    31→_STALE_NAME = "auto/stale-review"
    32→_UNSCORED_KEY = "subjective::unscored"
    33→_UNSCORED_NAME = "auto/initial-review"
    34→_UNDER_TARGET_KEY = "subjective::under-target"
    35→_UNDER_TARGET_NAME = "auto/under-target-review"
    36→_MIN_UNSCORED_CLUSTER_SIZE = 1
    37→
    38→
    39→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    40→class SubjectiveClusterSpec:
    41→    cluster_key: str
    42→    cluster_name: str
    43→    member_ids: list[str]
    44→    description: str
    45→    action: str
    46→    optional: bool = False
    47→
    48→
    49→def _subjective_state_sets(
    50→    state: StateModel,
    51→    *,
    52→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None,
    53→    target_strict: float,
    54→) -> tuple[set, set, set]:
    55→    """Return (stale_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_ids) for subjective cluster logic."""
    56→    if policy is not None:
    57→        unscored_ids = policy.unscored_ids
    58→        stale_ids = policy.stale_ids
    59→        under_target_ids = policy.under_target_ids
    60→    else:
    61→        unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
    62→        stale_ids = stale_policy_mod.current_stale_ids(
    63→            state, subjective_prefix=SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX
    64→        )
    65→        under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
    66→    return stale_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_ids
    67→
    68→
    69→def _skipped_subjective_ids(plan: dict) -> set[str]:
    70→    """Return skipped subjective IDs so auto-clusters don't re-queue them."""
    71→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
    72→    if not isinstance(skipped, dict):
    73→        return set()
    74→    return {
    75→        str(fid)
    76→        for fid in skipped
    77→        if isinstance(fid, str) and fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
    78→    }
    79→
    80→
    81→def _subjective_cli_keys(issue_ids: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    82→    return [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in issue_ids]
    83→
    84→
    85→def _subjective_action(issue_ids: list[str]) -> str:
    86→    return "desloppify review --prepare --dimensions " + ",".join(_subjective_cli_keys(issue_ids))
    87→
    88→
    89→def _sync_subjective_cluster(
    90→    *,
    91→    plan: dict,
    92→    clusters: dict,
    93→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
    94→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
    95→    cluster_key: str,
    96→    cluster_name: str,
    97→    member_ids: list[str],
    98→    description: str,
    99→    action: str,
   100→    now: str,
   101→    optional: bool = False,
   102→) -> int:
   103→    """Sync one subjective auto-cluster when it has enough members."""
   104→    min_size = _MIN_UNSCORED_CLUSTER_SIZE if cluster_key == _UNSCORED_KEY else _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE
   105→    if len(member_ids) < min_size:
   106→        return 0
   107→    active_auto_keys.add(cluster_key)
   108→    sync_result = _sync_auto_cluster(
   109→        plan,
   110→        clusters,
   111→        existing_by_key,
   112→        cluster_key=cluster_key,
   113→        cluster_name=cluster_name,
   114→        member_ids=member_ids,
   115→        description=description,
   116→        action=action,
   117→        now=now,
   118→        optional=optional,
   119→    )
   120→    return int(sync_result.changed)
   121→
   122→
   123→def _queue_subjective_members(
   124→    order: list[str],
   125→    *,
   126→    stale_state_ids: set[str],
   127→    under_target_ids: set[str],
   128→    unscored_state_ids: set[str],
   129→) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], list[str]]:
   130→    all_subjective_ids = sorted(
   131→        fid
   132→        for fid in order
   133→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   134→    )
   135→    unscored_queue_ids = sorted(
   136→        fid for fid in all_subjective_ids if fid in unscored_state_ids
   137→    )
   138→    stale_queue_ids = sorted(
   139→        fid
   140→        for fid in all_subjective_ids
   141→        if fid in stale_state_ids and fid not in unscored_state_ids
   142→    )
   143→    under_target_queue_ids = sorted(fid for fid in under_target_ids)
   144→    return unscored_queue_ids, stale_queue_ids, under_target_queue_ids
   145→
   146→
   147→def _subjective_cluster_specs(
   148→    *,
   149→    unscored_queue_ids: list[str],
   150→    stale_queue_ids: list[str],
   151→    under_target_queue_ids: list[str],
   152→    skipped_subjective_ids: set[str],
   153→    has_objective_items: bool,
   154→) -> list[SubjectiveClusterSpec]:
   155→    specs = [
   156→        SubjectiveClusterSpec(
   157→            cluster_key=_UNSCORED_KEY,
   158→            cluster_name=_UNSCORED_NAME,
   159→            member_ids=unscored_queue_ids,
   160→            description=(
   161→                f"Initial review of {len(unscored_queue_ids)} unscored subjective dimensions"
   162→            ),
   163→            action=_subjective_action(unscored_queue_ids),
   164→        ),
   165→        SubjectiveClusterSpec(
   166→            cluster_key=_STALE_KEY,
   167→            cluster_name=_STALE_NAME,
   168→            member_ids=stale_queue_ids,
   169→            description=f"Re-review {len(stale_queue_ids)} stale subjective dimensions",
   170→            action=_subjective_action(stale_queue_ids),
   171→        ),
   172→    ]
   173→    if has_objective_items:
   174→        return specs
   175→
   176→    filtered_under_target_ids = sorted(
   177→        fid for fid in under_target_queue_ids if fid not in skipped_subjective_ids
   178→    )
   179→    specs.append(
   180→        SubjectiveClusterSpec(
   181→            [REDACTED],
   182→            cluster_name=_UNDER_TARGET_NAME,
   183→            member_ids=filtered_under_target_ids,
   184→            description=(
   185→                f"Consider re-reviewing {len(filtered_under_target_ids)} "
   186→                f"dimensions under target score"
   187→            ),
   188→            action=_subjective_action(filtered_under_target_ids),
   189→            optional=True,
   190→        )
   191→    )
   192→    return specs
   193→
   194→
   195→def sync_subjective_clusters(
   196→    plan: dict,
   197→    state: StateModel,
   198→    issues: dict,
   199→    clusters: dict,
   200→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   201→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
   202→    now: str,
   203→    *,
   204→    target_strict: float,
   205→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   206→) -> int:
   207→    """Sync unscored, stale, and under-target subjective dimension clusters.
   208→
   209→    Creates/updates cluster groupings from IDs currently in the queue.
   210→    Does NOT inject or evict IDs — that is sync_stale's responsibility.
   211→    """
   212→    changes = 0
   213→    skipped_subjective_ids = _skipped_subjective_ids(plan)
   214→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   215→
   216→    stale_state_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_state_ids = _subjective_state_sets(
   217→        state, policy=policy, target_strict=target_strict
   218→    )
   219→    unscored_queue_ids, stale_queue_ids, under_target_queue_ids = _queue_subjective_members(
   220→        order,
   221→        stale_state_ids=stale_state_ids,
   222→        under_target_ids=under_target_ids,
   223→        unscored_state_ids=unscored_state_ids,
   224→    )
   225→
   226→    has_objective_items = _has_objective_backlog(issues, policy)
   227→    for spec in _subjective_cluster_specs(
   228→        unscored_queue_ids=unscored_queue_ids,
   229→        stale_queue_ids=stale_queue_ids,
   230→        under_target_queue_ids=under_target_queue_ids,
   231→        skipped_subjective_ids=skipped_subjective_ids,
   232→        has_objective_items=has_objective_items,
   233→    ):
   234→        changes += _sync_subjective_cluster(
   235→            plan=plan,
   236→            clusters=clusters,
   237→            existing_by_key=existing_by_key,
   238→            active_auto_keys=active_auto_keys,
   239→            [REDACTED],
   240→            cluster_name=spec.cluster_name,
   241→            member_ids=spec.member_ids,
   242→            description=spec.description,
   243→            action=spec.action,
   244→            now=now,
   245→            optional=spec.optional,
   246→        )
   247→
   248→    return changes
   249→
   250→
   251→__all__ = ["prune_stale_clusters", "sync_issue_clusters", "sync_subjective_clusters"]
   252→

1→"""Prompt/data contracts for whole-plan triage orchestration."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     6→from typing import Any
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import (
     9→    Cluster,
    10→    PlanModel,
    11→    ensure_plan_defaults,
    12→    triage_clusters,

    14→from desloppify.engine._plan.triage.snapshot import build_triage_snapshot
    15→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    16→
    17→
    18→@dataclass(init=False)
    19→class TriageInput:
    20→    """All data needed to produce/update triage clusters."""
    21→
    22→    review_issues: dict[str, dict]       # id -> issue (review + concerns)
    23→    objective_backlog_issues: dict[str, dict]  # id -> issue (non-review, for context)
    24→    existing_clusters: dict[str, Cluster]
    25→    dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]      # for context
    26→    new_since_last: set[str]             # issue IDs new since last triage
    27→    resolved_since_last: set[str]        # issue IDs resolved since last
    28→    previously_dismissed: list[str]      # IDs dismissed in prior triage
    29→    triage_version: int                  # next version number
    30→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict]   # full issue objects for resolved IDs
    31→    completed_clusters: list[dict]       # clusters completed since last triage
    32→
    33→    def __init__(
    34→        self,
    35→        *,
    36→        review_issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
    37→        objective_backlog_issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
    38→        existing_clusters: dict[str, Cluster],
    39→        dimension_scores: dict[str, Any],
    40→        new_since_last: set[str],
    41→        resolved_since_last: set[str],
    42→        previously_dismissed: list[str],
    43→        triage_version: int,
    44→        resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
    45→        completed_clusters: list[dict],
    46→        open_issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
    47→        mechanical_issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
    48→    ) -> None:
    49→        if review_issues is not None and open_issues is not None:
    50→            raise TypeError("Pass either review_issues or open_issues, not both.")
    51→        if objective_backlog_issues is not None and mechanical_issues is not None:
    52→            raise TypeError(
    53→                "Pass either objective_backlog_issues or mechanical_issues, not both."
    54→            )
    55→
    56→        self.review_issues = (
    57→            review_issues
    58→            if review_issues is not None
    59→            else (open_issues if open_issues is not None else {})
    60→        )
    61→        self.objective_backlog_issues = (
    62→            objective_backlog_issues
    63→            if objective_backlog_issues is not None
    64→            else (mechanical_issues if mechanical_issues is not None else {})
    65→        )
    66→        self.existing_clusters = existing_clusters
    67→        self.dimension_scores = dimension_scores
    68→        self.new_since_last = new_since_last
    69→        self.resolved_since_last = resolved_since_last
    70→        self.previously_dismissed = previously_dismissed
    71→        self.triage_version = triage_version
    72→        self.resolved_issues = resolved_issues
    73→        self.completed_clusters = completed_clusters
    74→
    75→    @property
    76→    def open_issues(self) -> dict[str, dict]:
    77→        """Backward-compatible alias for older triage callsites."""
    78→        return self.review_issues
    79→
    80→    @property
    81→    def mechanical_issues(self) -> dict[str, dict]:
    82→        """Backward-compatible alias for older triage callsites."""

    84→
    85→@dataclass
    86→class DismissedIssue:
    87→    """A issue the LLM says doesn't make sense."""
    88→
    89→    issue_id: str
    90→    reason: str
    91→
    92→@dataclass
    93→class ContradictionNote:
    94→    """Record of a resolved contradiction."""
    95→
    96→    kept: str
    97→    dismissed: str
    98→    reason: str
    99→
   100→@dataclass
   101→class TriageResult:
   102→    """Parsed and validated LLM triage output."""
   103→
   104→    strategy_summary: str
   105→    epics: list[dict]
   106→    dismissed_issues: list[DismissedIssue] = field(default_factory=list)
   107→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = field(default_factory=list)
   108→    priority_rationale: str = ""
   109→
   110→    @property
   111→    def clusters(self) -> list[dict]:
   112→        """Canonical cluster view for triage results."""
   113→        return self.epics
   114→
   115→
   116→def _issue_dimension(issue: dict) -> str:
   117→    detail = issue.get("detail", {})
   118→    if isinstance(detail, dict):
   119→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   120→        if isinstance(dimension, str):
   121→            return dimension
   122→    return ""
   123→
   124→
   125→def _recurring_dimensions(
   126→    review_issues: dict[str, dict],
   127→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
   128→) -> dict[str, dict[str, list[str]]]:
   129→    open_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   130→    for issue_id, issue in review_issues.items():
   131→        dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   132→        if dimension:
   133→            open_by_dim.setdefault(dimension, []).append(issue_id)
   134→
   135→    resolved_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   136→    for issue_id, issue in resolved_issues.items():
   137→        dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   138→        if dimension:
   139→            resolved_by_dim.setdefault(dimension, []).append(issue_id)
   140→
   141→    recurring: dict[str, dict[str, list[str]]] = {}
   142→    for dimension in sorted(set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim)):
   143→        recurring[dimension] = {
   144→            "open": sorted(open_by_dim[dimension]),
   145→            "resolved": sorted(resolved_by_dim[dimension]),
   146→        }
   147→    return recurring
   148→
   149→
   150→def _split_open_issue_buckets(
   151→    issues: dict[str, dict],
   152→) -> tuple[dict[str, dict], dict[str, dict]]:
   153→    open_review: dict[str, dict] = {}
   154→    open_mechanical: dict[str, dict] = {}
   155→    for issue_id, issue in issues.items():
   156→        if issue.get("status") != "open":
   157→            continue
   158→        if issue.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns"):
   159→            open_review[issue_id] = issue
   160→            continue
   161→        open_mechanical[issue_id] = issue
   162→    return open_review, open_mechanical
   163→
   164→
   165→def _recent_completed_clusters(meta: dict, plan: PlanModel) -> list[dict]:
   166→    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
   167→    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
   168→    if not last_completed:
   169→        return list(all_completed)
   170→    return [
   171→        cluster for cluster in all_completed
   172→        if cluster.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
   173→    ]
   174→
   175→
   176→def collect_triage_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> TriageInput:
   177→    """Gather all data needed for the triage LLM prompt."""
   178→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   179→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   180→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   181→    epics = triage_clusters(plan)
   182→    open_review, open_mechanical = _split_open_issue_buckets(issues)
   183→    snapshot = build_triage_snapshot(plan, state)
   184→
   185→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   186→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   187→    new_since = set(snapshot.new_since_triage_ids)
   188→    resolved_since = triaged_ids - current_review_ids
   189→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   190→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   191→
   192→    # Resolved issue objects (for REFLECT stage)
   193→    resolved_issue_objs = {
   194→        fid: issues[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in issues
   195→    }
   196→
   197→    return TriageInput(
   198→        review_issues=open_review,
   199→        objective_backlog_issues=open_mechanical,
   200→        existing_clusters=dict(epics),
   201→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   202→        new_since_last=new_since,
   203→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   204→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   205→        triage_version=version,
   206→        resolved_issues=resolved_issue_objs,
   207→        completed_clusters=_recent_completed_clusters(meta, plan),
   208→    )
   209→
   210→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   211→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Produce a coherent
   212→prioritized strategy for all open review issues, and decide which mechanical
   213→backlog items should be promoted into the active queue now.
   214→
   215→Your plan should:
   216→- Cluster issues by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   217→- Give each cluster a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   218→- Order clusters by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   219→- Dismiss issues that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   220→- Mark which clusters are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   221→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   222→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all issues coherently
   223→
   224→Available directions for clusters: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   225→
   226→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   227→- `desloppify plan queue` — view the explicit execution queue in priority order
   228→- `desloppify backlog` — inspect broader open work outside the execution queue
   229→- `desloppify plan promote <id-or-pattern>` — move backlog work into the active queue
   230→- `desloppify plan focus <name>` — focus the queue on one cluster
   231→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   232→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   233→- `desloppify plan resolve <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   234→- `desloppify plan reorder <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   235→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   236→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   237→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review issues
   238→
   239→Your output defines the active work plan for review findings and any explicitly
   240→promoted backlog work. Mechanical backlog items you do not mention remain in
   241→backlog by default. Dismissed issues will be removed from the queue with your
   242→stated reason.
   243→
   244→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   245→{
   246→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   247→  "clusters": [
   248→    {
   249→      "name": "slug-name",
   250→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   251→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   252→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   253→      "issue_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   254→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   255→      "agent_safe": true,
   256→      "dependency_order": 1,
   257→      "action_steps": [
   258→        {
   259→          "title": "Short imperative step title",
   260→          "detail": "Concrete implementation detail with file paths/locations",
   261→          "issue_refs": ["id1"]
   262→        }
   263→      ],
   264→      "status": "pending"
   265→    }
   266→  ],
   267→  "dismissed_issues": [
   268→    {"issue_id": "id", "reason": "why this issue doesn't make sense"}
   269→  ],
   270→  "contradiction_notes": [
   271→    {"kept": "issue_id", "dismissed": "issue_id", "reason": "why"}
   272→  ],
   273→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   274→}
   275→"""
   276→
   277→def _append_existing_clusters_section(parts: list[str], clusters: dict[str, Cluster]) -> None:
   278→    if not clusters:
   279→        return
   280→    parts.append("## Existing clusters")
   281→    for name, cluster in sorted(clusters.items()):
   282→        status = cluster.get("status", "pending")
   283→        thesis = cluster.get("thesis", "")
   284→        direction = cluster.get("direction", "")
   285→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   286→        parts.append(
   287→            f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   288→            f"\n  Issues: {', '.join(issue_ids[:10])}"
   289→            f"{'...' if len(issue_ids) > 10 else ''}"
   290→        )
   291→    parts.append("")
   292→
   293→
   294→def _append_changed_issue_section(
   295→    parts: list[str],
   296→    *,
   297→    title: str,
   298→    issue_ids: set[str],
   299→    issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
   300→) -> None:
   301→    if not issue_ids:
   302→        return
   303→    parts.append(f"## {title} ({len(issue_ids)})")
   304→    for issue_id in sorted(issue_ids):
   305→        if issues is None:
   306→            parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   307→            continue
   308→        issue = issues.get(issue_id, {})
   309→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}: {issue.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   310→    parts.append("")
   311→
   312→
   313→def _append_resolved_issue_context(parts: list[str], resolved_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   314→    if not resolved_issues:
   315→        return
   316→    parts.append(
   317→        "## Resolved review issues available for recurrence context "
   318→        f"({len(resolved_issues)})"
   319→    )
   320→    resolved_ids = sorted(resolved_issues)
   321→    for issue_id in resolved_ids[:30]:
   322→        issue = resolved_issues.get(issue_id, {})
   323→        summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   324→        dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   325→        dim_suffix = f" [{dimension}]" if dimension else ""
   326→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}{dim_suffix}: {summary}")
   327→    if len(resolved_ids) > 30:
   328→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(resolved_ids) - 30} more resolved issues")
   329→    parts.append("")
   330→
   331→
   332→def _append_completed_clusters_section(parts: list[str], completed_clusters: list[dict]) -> None:
   333→    if not completed_clusters:
   334→        return
   335→    parts.append(
   336→        "## Completed clusters since last triage "
   337→        f"({len(completed_clusters)})"
   338→    )
   339→    completed = sorted(
   340→        completed_clusters,
   341→        key=lambda cluster: str(cluster.get("completed_at", "")),
   342→        reverse=True,
   343→    )
   344→    for cluster in completed[:10]:
   345→        name = str(cluster.get("name", "(unnamed cluster)"))
   346→        thesis = str(cluster.get("thesis") or cluster.get("description") or "")
   347→        completed_at = str(cluster.get("completed_at", ""))
   348→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   349→        issue_count = len(issue_ids) if isinstance(issue_ids, list) else 0
   350→        parts.append(
   351→            f"- {name}: {thesis} (issues: {issue_count}, completed_at: {completed_at})"
   352→        )
   353→    if len(completed) > 10:
   354→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(completed) - 10} more completed clusters")
   355→    parts.append("")
   356→
   357→
   358→def _append_recurring_dimensions_section(
   359→    parts: list[str],
   360→    review_issues: dict[str, dict],
   361→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
   362→) -> None:
   363→    recurring = _recurring_dimensions(review_issues, resolved_issues)
   364→    if not recurring:
   365→        return
   366→    parts.append(
   367→        "## Potential recurring dimensions (resolved issues still have open peers)"
   368→    )
   369→    for dimension, bucket in recurring.items():
   370→        open_count = len(bucket["open"])
   371→        resolved_count = len(bucket["resolved"])
   372→        parts.append(
   373→            f"- {dimension}: {open_count} open / {resolved_count} recently resolved"
   374→        )
   375→    parts.append("")
   376→
   377→
   378→def _append_open_review_issues_section(parts: list[str], review_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   379→    parts.append(f"## All open review issues ({len(review_issues)})")
   380→    for issue_id, issue in sorted(review_issues.items()):
   381→        detail = issue.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(issue.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   382→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   383→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   384→        confidence = issue.get("confidence", "medium")
   385→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
   386→        summary = issue.get("summary", "")
   387→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id}")
   388→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   389→        if dimension:
   390→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   391→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   392→        if suggestion:
   393→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   394→    parts.append("")
   395→
   396→
   397→def _append_dimension_scores_section(parts: list[str], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   398→    if not dimension_scores:
   399→        return
   400→    parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   401→    for name, data in sorted(dimension_scores.items()):
   402→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   403→            continue
   404→        score = data.get("score", "?")
   405→        strict = data.get("strict", score)
   406→        issues = data.get("failing", 0)
   407→        parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   408→    parts.append("")
   409→
   410→
   411→def _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   412→    parts: list[str],
   413→    objective_backlog_issues: dict[str, dict],
   414→) -> None:
   415→    if not objective_backlog_issues:
   416→        return
   417→    parts.append(
   418→        "## Mechanical backlog context "
   419→        f"({len(objective_backlog_issues)} open detector-created items)"
   420→    )
   421→    parts.append(
   422→        "These items are backlog by default. Promote only the ones that should become active queue work now."
   423→    )
   424→    parts.append(
   425→        "If you do not mention a mechanical backlog item in your strategy, it stays in backlog."
   426→    )
   427→
   428→    by_detector: dict[str, int] = {}
   429→    for issue in objective_backlog_issues.values():
   430→        detector = str(issue.get("detector", "unknown"))
   431→        by_detector[detector] = by_detector.get(detector, 0) + 1
   432→
   433→    if by_detector:
   434→        parts.append("### Detector summary")
   435→        for detector, count in sorted(by_detector.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0])):
   436→            parts.append(f"- {detector}: {count}")
   437→
   438→    parts.append("### Sample backlog items")
   439→    sample_ids = sorted(objective_backlog_issues)[:20]
   440→    for issue_id in sample_ids:
   441→        issue = objective_backlog_issues.get(issue_id, {})
   442→        file_path = str(issue.get("file", ""))
   443→        summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   444→        detector = str(issue.get("detector", "unknown"))
   445→        parts.append(f"- [{detector}] {issue_id}")
   446→        if file_path:
   447→            parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   448→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   449→    if len(objective_backlog_issues) > len(sample_ids):
   450→        parts.append(
   451→            f"- ... and {len(objective_backlog_issues) - len(sample_ids)} more backlog items"
   452→        )
   453→    parts.append("")
   454→
   455→
   456→def _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts: list[str], dismissed_ids: list[str]) -> None:
   457→    if not dismissed_ids:
   458→        return
   459→    parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(dismissed_ids)})")
   460→    parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   461→    for issue_id in dismissed_ids:
   462→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   463→    parts.append("")
   464→
   465→
   466→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   467→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   468→    parts: list[str] = []
   469→    _append_existing_clusters_section(parts, si.existing_clusters)
   470→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   471→        parts,
   472→        title="New issues since last triage",
   473→        issue_ids=si.new_since_last,
   474→        issues=si.review_issues,
   475→    )
   476→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   477→        parts,
   478→        title="Resolved since last triage",
   479→        issue_ids=si.resolved_since_last,
   480→    )
   481→    _append_resolved_issue_context(parts, si.resolved_issues)
   482→    _append_completed_clusters_section(parts, si.completed_clusters)
   483→    _append_recurring_dimensions_section(parts, si.review_issues, si.resolved_issues)
   484→    _append_open_review_issues_section(parts, si.review_issues)
   485→    _append_dimension_scores_section(parts, si.dimension_scores)
   486→    _append_mechanical_backlog_section(parts, si.objective_backlog_issues)
   487→    _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts, si.previously_dismissed)
   488→    return "\n".join(parts)
   489→
   490→__all__ = [
   491→    "_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
   492→    "ContradictionNote",
   493→    "DismissedIssue",
   494→    "TriageInput",
   495→    "TriageResult",
   496→    "build_triage_prompt",

    25→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:

    30→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    31→    if not threshold:

    40→def enrich_plan_metadata(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> None:

    64→def stamp_plan_sort_keys(

    69→    """Stamp ``_plan_position`` and ``_is_new`` on each item.

   127→def stamp_positions(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> None:

   130→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
