    39→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    40→class SubjectiveClusterSpec:
    41→    cluster_key: str
    42→    cluster_name: str
    43→    member_ids: list[str]
    44→    description: str
    45→    action: str
    46→    optional: bool = False
    47→
    48→
    49→def _subjective_state_sets(
    50→    state: StateModel,
    51→    *,
    52→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None,
    53→    target_strict: float,
    54→) -> tuple[set, set, set]:
    55→    """Return (stale_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_ids) for subjective cluster logic."""
    56→    if policy is not None:
    57→        unscored_ids = policy.unscored_ids
    58→        stale_ids = policy.stale_ids
    59→        under_target_ids = policy.under_target_ids
    60→    else:
    61→        unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
    62→        stale_ids = stale_policy_mod.current_stale_ids(
    63→            state, subjective_prefix=SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX
    64→        )
    65→        under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
    66→    return stale_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_ids
    67→
    68→
    69→def _skipped_subjective_ids(plan: dict) -> set[str]:
    70→    """Return skipped subjective IDs so auto-clusters don't re-queue them."""
    71→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
    72→    if not isinstance(skipped, dict):
    73→        return set()
    74→    return {
    75→        str(fid)
    76→        for fid in skipped
    77→        if isinstance(fid, str) and fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
    78→    }
    79→
    80→
    81→def _subjective_cli_keys(issue_ids: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    82→    return [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in issue_ids]
    83→
    84→
    85→def _subjective_action(issue_ids: list[str]) -> str:
    86→    return "desloppify review --prepare --dimensions " + ",".join(_subjective_cli_keys(issue_ids))
    87→
    88→
    89→def _sync_subjective_cluster(
    90→    *,
    91→    plan: dict,
    92→    clusters: dict,
    93→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
    94→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
    95→    cluster_key: str,
    96→    cluster_name: str,
    97→    member_ids: list[str],
    98→    description: str,
    99→    action: str,
   100→    now: str,
   101→    optional: bool = False,
   102→) -> int:
   103→    """Sync one subjective auto-cluster when it has enough members."""
   104→    min_size = _MIN_UNSCORED_CLUSTER_SIZE if cluster_key == _UNSCORED_KEY else _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE
   105→    if len(member_ids) < min_size:
   106→        return 0
   107→    active_auto_keys.add(cluster_key)
   108→    sync_result = _sync_auto_cluster(
   109→        plan,
   110→        clusters,
   111→        existing_by_key,
   112→        cluster_key=cluster_key,
   113→        cluster_name=cluster_name,
   114→        member_ids=member_ids,
   115→        description=description,
   116→        action=action,
   117→        now=now,
   118→        optional=optional,
   119→    )
   120→    return int(sync_result.changed)
   121→
   122→
   123→def _queue_subjective_members(
   124→    order: list[str],
   125→    *,
   126→    stale_state_ids: set[str],
   127→    under_target_ids: set[str],
   128→    unscored_state_ids: set[str],
   129→) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], list[str]]:
   130→    all_subjective_ids = sorted(
   131→        fid
   132→        for fid in order
   133→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   134→    )
   135→    unscored_queue_ids = sorted(
   136→        fid for fid in all_subjective_ids if fid in unscored_state_ids
   137→    )
   138→    stale_queue_ids = sorted(
   139→        fid
   140→        for fid in all_subjective_ids
   141→        if fid in stale_state_ids and fid not in unscored_state_ids
   142→    )
   143→    under_target_queue_ids = sorted(fid for fid in under_target_ids)
   144→    return unscored_queue_ids, stale_queue_ids, under_target_queue_ids
   145→
   146→
   147→def _subjective_cluster_specs(
   148→    *,
   149→    unscored_queue_ids: list[str],
   150→    stale_queue_ids: list[str],
   151→    under_target_queue_ids: list[str],
   152→    skipped_subjective_ids: set[str],
   153→    has_objective_items: bool,
   154→) -> list[SubjectiveClusterSpec]:
   155→    specs = [
   156→        SubjectiveClusterSpec(
   157→            cluster_key=_UNSCORED_KEY,
   158→            cluster_name=_UNSCORED_NAME,
   159→            member_ids=unscored_queue_ids,
   160→            description=(
   161→                f"Initial review of {len(unscored_queue_ids)} unscored subjective dimensions"
   162→            ),
   163→            action=_subjective_action(unscored_queue_ids),
   164→        ),
   165→        SubjectiveClusterSpec(
   166→            cluster_key=_STALE_KEY,
   167→            cluster_name=_STALE_NAME,
   168→            member_ids=stale_queue_ids,
   169→            description=f"Re-review {len(stale_queue_ids)} stale subjective dimensions",
   170→            action=_subjective_action(stale_queue_ids),
   171→        ),
   172→    ]
   173→    if has_objective_items:
   174→        return specs
   175→
   176→    filtered_under_target_ids = sorted(
   177→        fid for fid in under_target_queue_ids if fid not in skipped_subjective_ids
   178→    )
   179→    specs.append(
   180→        SubjectiveClusterSpec(
   181→            [REDACTED],
   182→            cluster_name=_UNDER_TARGET_NAME,
   183→            member_ids=filtered_under_target_ids,
   184→            description=(
   185→                f"Consider re-reviewing {len(filtered_under_target_ids)} "
   186→                f"dimensions under target score"
   187→            ),
   188→            action=_subjective_action(filtered_under_target_ids),
   189→            optional=True,
   190→        )
   191→    )
   192→    return specs
   193→
   194→
   195→def sync_subjective_clusters(
   196→    plan: dict,
   197→    state: StateModel,
   198→    issues: dict,
   199→    clusters: dict,
   200→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   201→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
   202→    now: str,
   203→    *,
   204→    target_strict: float,
   205→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   206→) -> int:
   207→    """Sync unscored, stale, and under-target subjective dimension clusters.
   208→
   209→    Creates/updates cluster groupings from IDs currently in the queue.
   210→    Does NOT inject or evict IDs — that is sync_stale's responsibility.
   211→    """
   212→    changes = 0
   213→    skipped_subjective_ids = _skipped_subjective_ids(plan)
   214→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   215→
   216→    stale_state_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_state_ids = _subjective_state_sets(
   217→        state, policy=policy, target_strict=target_strict
   218→    )
   219→    unscored_queue_ids, stale_queue_ids, under_target_queue_ids = _queue_subjective_members(
   220→        order,
   221→        stale_state_ids=stale_state_ids,
   222→        under_target_ids=under_target_ids,
   223→        unscored_state_ids=unscored_state_ids,
   224→    )
   225→
   226→    has_objective_items = _has_objective_backlog(issues, policy)
   227→    for spec in _subjective_cluster_specs(
   228→        unscored_queue_ids=unscored_queue_ids,
   229→        stale_queue_ids=stale_queue_ids,
   230→        under_target_queue_ids=under_target_queue_ids,
   231→        skipped_subjective_ids=skipped_subjective_ids,
   232→        has_objective_items=has_objective_items,
   233→    ):
   234→        changes += _sync_subjective_cluster(
   235→            plan=plan,
   236→            clusters=clusters,
   237→            existing_by_key=existing_by_key,
   238→            active_auto_keys=active_auto_keys,
   239→            [REDACTED],
   240→            cluster_name=spec.cluster_name,
   241→            member_ids=spec.member_ids,
   242→            description=spec.description,
   243→            action=spec.action,
   244→            now=now,
   245→            optional=spec.optional,
   246→        )
   247→
   248→    return changes
   249→
   250→
   251→__all__ = ["prune_stale_clusters", "sync_issue_clusters", "sync_subjective_clusters"]
   252→

   309→def run_codex_pipeline(
   310→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   311→    *,
   312→    stages_to_run: list[str],
   313→    services: TriageServices | None = None,
   314→) -> None:
   315→    """Run triage stages via Codex subprocesses (automated pipeline)."""
   316→    resolved_services = services or default_triage_services()
   317→    timeout_seconds = int(getattr(args, "stage_timeout_seconds", 1800) or 1800)
   318→    dry_run = bool(getattr(args, "dry_run", False))
   319→
   320→    repo_root = get_project_root()
   321→    runtime = resolved_services.command_runtime(args)
   322→    state = runtime.state
   323→    plan = resolved_services.load_plan()
   324→    start_outcome = ensure_triage_started(
   325→        plan,
   326→        services=resolved_services,
   327→        state=state,
   328→        attestation=getattr(args, "attestation", None),
   329→        log_action="triage_auto_start",
   330→        log_actor="system",
   331→        log_detail={
   332→            "source": "runner_auto_start",
   333→            "runner": "codex",
   334→            "injected_stage_ids": list(STAGES),
   335→        },
   336→        start_message="  Planning mode auto-started.",
   337→        deps=TriageLifecycleDeps(
   338→            has_triage_in_queue=has_triage_in_queue,
   339→            inject_triage_stages=inject_triage_stages,
   340→        ),
   341→    )
   342→    if getattr(start_outcome, "status", None) == "blocked":
   343→        return
   344→    plan = resolved_services.load_plan()
   345→
   346→    stamp = run_stamp()
   347→    desloppify_dir = repo_root / ".desloppify"
   348→    run_dir = desloppify_dir / "triage_runs" / stamp
   349→    prompts_dir = run_dir / "prompts"
   350→    output_dir = run_dir / "output"
   351→    logs_dir = run_dir / "logs"
   352→    for output_path in (prompts_dir, output_dir, logs_dir):
   353→        output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   354→
   355→    run_log_path = run_dir / "run.log"
   356→    append_run_log = make_run_log_writer(run_log_path)
   357→    cli_helper = _write_desloppify_cli_helper(run_dir)
   358→    append_run_log(
   359→        f"run-start runner=codex stages={','.join(stages_to_run)} "
   360→        f"timeout={timeout_seconds}s dry_run={dry_run}"
   361→    )
   362→
   363→    pipeline_context = PipelineRunContext(
   364→        args=args,
   365→        services=resolved_services,
   366→        state=state,
   367→        stages_to_run=stages_to_run,
   368→        timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
   369→        dry_run=dry_run,
   370→        repo_root=repo_root,
   371→        stamp=stamp,
   372→        run_dir=run_dir,
   373→        prompts_dir=prompts_dir,
   374→        output_dir=output_dir,

   376→        run_log_path=run_log_path,
   377→        cli_command=str(cli_helper),
   378→        append_run_log=append_run_log,
   379→    )
   380→
   381→    print(colorize(f"  Run artifacts: {pipeline_context.run_dir}", "dim"))
   382→    print(colorize(f"  Live run log:  {pipeline_context.run_log_path}", "dim"))
   383→    print(colorize(f"  CLI helper:    {pipeline_context.cli_command}", "dim"))
   384→
   385→    pipeline_start = time.monotonic()
   386→    stage_sequence = _run_stage_sequence(
   387→        pipeline_context=pipeline_context,
   388→        initial_plan=plan,
   389→    )
   390→    _finalize_pipeline_run(
   391→        pipeline_context=pipeline_context,
   392→        stage_results=stage_sequence.stage_results,
   393→        pipeline_start=pipeline_start,
   394→        last_triage_input=stage_sequence.last_triage_input,
   395→    )

   399→    run_dir: Path,
   400→    stamp: str,
   401→    stages: list[str],
   402→    stage_results: dict[str, dict],
   403→    append_run_log,
   404→    *,
   405→    finalized: bool | None = None,
   406→    finalization_reason: str | None = None,
   407→) -> None:
   408→    """Write a run_summary.json with per-stage results."""
   409→    summary = {
   410→        "created_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
   411→        "run_stamp": stamp,
   412→        "runner": "codex",
   413→        "stages_requested": stages,
   414→        "stage_results": stage_results,
   415→        "run_dir": str(run_dir),

   418→        summary["finalized"] = finalized
   419→    if finalization_reason:
   420→        summary["finalization_reason"] = finalization_reason
   421→    summary_path = run_dir / "run_summary.json"
   422→    safe_write_text(summary_path, json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
   423→    print(colorize(f"  Run summary: {summary_path}", "dim"))
   424→    append_run_log(f"run-summary {summary_path}")

   206→def collapse_clusters(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   207→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.
   208→
   209→    Both auto-clusters and manual (triage) clusters are collapsed.  Manual
   210→    clusters are inserted at the front in plan order so triage-prioritised
   211→    work appears before auto-clustered mechanical items.
   212→    """
   213→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   214→    if not clusters:
   215→        return items
   216→
   217→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   218→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   219→        for issue_id in _cluster_issue_ids(cluster):
   220→            # Manual clusters take priority when an issue is in both
   221→            if issue_id not in fid_to_cluster or not cluster.get("auto"):
   222→                fid_to_cluster[issue_id] = name
   223→
   224→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   225→        return items
   226→
   227→    # Collect members per cluster (preserving encounter order)
   228→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[WorkQueueItem]] = {}
   229→    for item in items:
   230→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   231→        if cname:
   232→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   233→
   234→    # Build meta-items only for clusters with 2+ members in the queue
   235→    meta_items: dict[str, WorkQueueItem] = {}
   236→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   237→        if len(members) < 2:
   238→            continue
   239→        meta_items[cname] = _build_cluster_meta(
   240→            cname, members, clusters.get(cname, {})
   241→        )
   242→
   243→    # Collect manual cluster names in plan order (for front-insertion)
   244→    manual_names = [
   245→        name for name in clusters
   246→        if not clusters[name].get("auto") and name in meta_items
   247→    ]
   248→
   249→    # Walk in order: replace first auto-cluster member with meta-item,
   250→    # skip subsequent members.  Manual cluster members are always skipped
   251→    # (they'll be inserted at the front).
   252→    seen_clusters: set[str] = set()
   253→    rest: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   254→    for item in items:
   255→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   256→        if cname and cname in meta_items:
   257→            if cname not in seen_clusters:
   258→                seen_clusters.add(cname)
   259→                # Auto-clusters collapse in-place; manual clusters go to front
   260→                if clusters.get(cname, {}).get("auto"):
   261→                    rest.append(meta_items[cname])
   262→            # skip individual member
   263→        else:
   264→            rest.append(item)
   265→
   266→    # Manual clusters at the front in plan order, then everything else
   267→    manual_result = [meta_items[name] for name in manual_names if name in seen_clusters]
   268→    return manual_result + rest
   269→

    23→def resolve_target(plan: dict, target: str | None, position: str) -> str | None:
    24→    """Resolve a cluster name used as a before/after target to a member ID."""
    25→    if target is None:
    26→        return None
    27→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    28→    if target not in clusters:
    29→        return target
    30→    member_ids = cluster_issue_ids(clusters[target])
    31→    if not member_ids:
    32→        return target
    33→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    34→    member_set = set(member_ids)
    35→    ordered = [fid for fid in order if fid in member_set]
    36→    if not ordered:
    37→        return member_ids[0]
    38→    return ordered[0] if position == "before" else ordered[-1]
    39→
    40→
    41→def cmd_plan_reorder(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    42→    """Reorder issues in the queue."""
    43→    state = command_runtime(args).state
    44→    if not require_issue_inventory(state):
    45→        return
    46→
    47→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
    48→    position: str = getattr(args, "position", "top")
    49→    target: str | None = getattr(args, "target", None)
    50→
    51→    if position in ("before", "after") and target is None:
    52→        print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires --target (-t). Example: plan reorder <pat> {position} -t <id>", "red"))
    53→        return
    54→    if position in ("up", "down") and target is None:
    55→        print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires --target (-t) with an integer offset. Example: plan reorder <pat> {position} -t 3", "red"))
    56→        return
    57→
    58→    plan = load_plan()
    59→
    60→    target = resolve_target(plan, target, position)
    61→
    62→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan)
    63→    if not issue_ids:
    64→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
    65→        return
    66→
    67→    offset: int | None = None

   106→
   107→    count = move_items(plan, issue_ids, position, target=target)
   108→    add_promoted_ids(plan, issue_ids)
   109→    append_log_entry(
   110→        plan,
   111→        "promote",
   112→        issue_ids=issue_ids,
   113→        actor="user",
   114→        detail={"position": position, "target": target},
   115→    )
   116→    save_plan(plan)
   117→    print(colorize(f"  Promoted {count} item(s) into the active queue.", "green"))
   118→
   119→
   120→__all__ = ["cmd_plan_promote", "cmd_plan_reorder", "resolve_target"]
   121→

   120→def _format_assessments_table(assessments: list[dict]) -> str:
   121→    """Format structured observe assessments as a readable table for downstream stages."""
   122→    if not assessments:
   123→        return ""
   124→    lines = ["### Structured Observe Assessments\n"]
   125→    lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   126→    lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   127→    for a in assessments:
   128→        h = a.get("hash", "?")
   129→        v = a.get("verdict", "?")
   130→        r = a.get("recommendation", "")
   131→        # Truncate recommendation for table readability
   132→        if len(r) > 80:
   133→            r = r[:77] + "..."
   134→        lines.append(f"| {h} | {v} | {r} |")
   135→    return "\n".join(lines)
   136→
   137→
   138→def _format_disposition_table(
   139→    dispositions: dict[str, dict],
   140→    assessments: list[dict],
   141→) -> str:
   142→    """Format the unified disposition map for downstream stages.
   143→
   144→    Partitions issues into:
   145→    - Auto-skipped by observe (false-positive/exaggerated)
   146→    - Genuine issues requiring disposition
   147→    - Actionability-flagged issues (over-engineering/not-worth-it)
   148→    """
   149→    if not dispositions and not assessments:
   150→        return ""
   151→
   152→    auto_skipped: list[dict] = []
   153→    genuine: list[dict] = []
   154→    actionability: list[dict] = []
   155→
   156→    # Build from assessments for hash display, enriched by dispositions
   157→    for a in assessments:
   158→        h = a.get("hash", "?")
   159→        v = a.get("verdict", "?")
   160→        r = a.get("recommendation", "")
   161→        if len(r) > 80:
   162→            r = r[:77] + "..."
   163→        entry = {"hash": h, "verdict": v, "recommendation": r}
   164→
   165→        if v in ("false positive", "exaggerated"):
   166→            auto_skipped.append(entry)
   167→        elif v in ("over engineering", "not worth it"):
   168→            actionability.append(entry)
   169→        else:
   170→            genuine.append(entry)
   171→
   172→    lines = ["### Issue Disposition Summary\n"]
   173→
   174→    if auto_skipped:
   175→        lines.append(f"**Auto-skipped by observe ({len(auto_skipped)} issues)** — no action needed:\n")
   176→        lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   177→        lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   178→        for e in auto_skipped:
   179→            lines.append(f"| {e['hash']} | {e['verdict']} | {e['recommendation']} |")
   180→        lines.append("")
   181→
   182→    if genuine:
   183→        lines.append(f"**Genuine issues requiring disposition ({len(genuine)} issues):**\n")
   184→        lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   185→        lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   186→        for e in genuine:
   187→            lines.append(f"| {e['hash']} | {e['verdict']} | {e['recommendation']} |")
   188→        lines.append("")
   189→
   190→    if actionability:
   191→        lines.append(
   192→            f"**Actionability-flagged issues ({len(actionability)} issues)** "
   193→            "— observe thinks these aren't worth it, reflect decides:\n"
   194→        )
   195→        lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   196→        lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   197→        for e in actionability:
   198→            lines.append(f"| {e['hash']} | {e['verdict']} | {e['recommendation']} |")
   199→        lines.append("")
   200→
   201→    return "\n".join(lines)
   202→

   204→def _format_assessment_file_evidence(assessments: list[dict]) -> str:
   205→    """Format file-level observe evidence for clustering-heavy downstream stages."""
   206→    if not assessments:
   207→        return ""
   208→    lines = ["### Observe File Evidence\n"]
   209→    for assessment in assessments:
   210→        issue_hash = str(assessment.get("hash", "?"))
   211→        files_read = [
   212→            str(path).strip()
   213→            for path in assessment.get("files_read", [])
   214→            if str(path).strip()
   215→        ]
   216→        verdict = str(assessment.get("verdict", "?")).strip() or "?"
   217→        reasoning = str(assessment.get("verdict_reasoning", "")).strip()
   218→        recommendation = str(assessment.get("recommendation", "")).strip()
   219→        lines.append(f"- {issue_hash}: {verdict}")
   220→        if files_read:
   221→            lines.append(f"  files_read: {', '.join(files_read)}")
   222→        if reasoning:
   223→            lines.append(f"  verdict_reasoning: {reasoning}")
   224→        if recommendation:
   225→            lines.append(f"  recommendation: {recommendation}")
   226→    return "\n".join(lines)

   229→def _relevant_prior_reports(
   230→    stage: str,
   231→    prior_reports: dict[str, str],
   232→    stages_data: dict | None = None,
   233→) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
   234→    """Return the stage reports that matter for the current stage."""
   235→    wanted = {
   236→        "reflect": ("observe",),
   237→        "organize": ("reflect",),
   238→        "enrich": ("organize",),
   239→        "sense-check": ("organize", "enrich"),
   240→    }.get(stage, tuple(prior_reports))
   241→    result = [(name, prior_reports[name]) for name in wanted if name in prior_reports]
   242→
   243→    # Append structured observe assessments / disposition table for downstream stages
   244→    if stage in {"reflect", "organize", "sense-check"} and stages_data:
   245→        observe_data = stages_data.get("observe", {})
   246→        assessments = observe_data.get("assessments", [])
   247→
   248→        # Use disposition table when dispositions exist, fall back to assessments table.
   249→        # Note: stages_data is the triage_stages dict; dispositions are on
   250→        # epic_triage_meta which we don't have here. Use assessments to build
   251→        # the partitioned view since the verdict info is the same.
   252→        if assessments:
   253→            disp_table = _format_disposition_table({}, assessments)
   254→            if disp_table:
   255→                result.append(("observe-dispositions", disp_table))
   256→            else:
   257→                table = _format_assessments_table(assessments)
   258→                if table:
   259→                    result.append(("observe-assessments", table))
   260→        if stage == "organize":
   261→            evidence = _format_assessment_file_evidence(assessments)
   262→            if evidence:
   263→                result.append(("observe-evidence", evidence))
   264→
   265→    return result
   266→
   267→
   268→def build_stage_prompt(
   269→    stage: str,
   270→    triage_input: TriageInput,
   271→    prior_reports: dict[str, str],
   272→    *,
   273→    repo_root: Path,
   274→    mode: PromptMode = "self_record",
   275→    cli_command: str = "desloppify",
   276→    stages_data: dict | None = None,
   277→) -> str:
   278→    """Build a complete subagent prompt for a triage stage."""
   279→    parts: list[str] = []
   280→
   281→    # Preamble
   282→    parts.append(
   283→        triage_prompt_preamble(mode).format(
   284→            stage=stage.upper(),
   285→            repo_root=repo_root,
   286→            cli_command=cli_command,
   287→        )
   288→    )
   289→
   290→    # Prior stage reports
   291→    relevant_prior_reports = _relevant_prior_reports(stage, prior_reports, stages_data)
   292→    if relevant_prior_reports:
   293→        parts.append("## Prior Stage Reports\n")
   294→        for prior_stage, report in relevant_prior_reports:
   295→            parts.append(f"### {prior_stage.upper()} Report\n{report}\n")
   296→
   297→    # Issue data / summary
   298→    parts.append(_issue_context_for_stage(stage, triage_input, mode))
   299→
   300→    # Stage-specific instructions
   301→    instruction_fn = _STAGE_INSTRUCTIONS.get(stage)
   302→    if instruction_fn:
   303→        parts.append(instruction_fn(mode))
   304→
   305→    # CLI reference
   306→    if mode == "self_record":
   307→        parts.append(render_cli_reference(cli_command))
   308→
   309→    # Validation requirements
   310→    parts.append(_validation_requirements(stage))
   311→
   312→    return "\n\n".join(parts)
   313→
   314→
   315→def cmd_stage_prompt(
   316→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   317→    *,
   318→    services: TriageServices | None = None,
   319→) -> None:
   320→    """Print the current prompt for a triage stage, built from live plan data."""
   321→    stage = args.stage_prompt
   322→    resolved_services = services or default_triage_services()
   323→    plan = resolved_services.load_plan()
   324→    runtime = resolved_services.command_runtime(args)
   325→    state = runtime.state
   326→    si = resolved_services.collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   327→    repo_root = get_project_root()
   328→
   329→    # Extract real prior reports from plan.json
   330→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   331→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   332→    prior_reports: dict[str, str] = {}
   333→    for prior_stage in _STAGES:
   334→        if prior_stage == stage:
   335→            break
   336→        report = stages.get(prior_stage, {}).get("report", "")
   337→        if report:
   338→            prior_reports[prior_stage] = report
   339→
   340→    prompt = build_stage_prompt(stage, si, prior_reports, repo_root=repo_root, stages_data=stages)
   341→    print(prompt)
   342→

    25→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    26→class AutoClusterSyncResult:

    35→def _manual_member_ids(clusters: dict) -> set[str]:
    36→    """Collect all issue IDs belonging to manual (non-auto) clusters."""
    37→    ids: set[str] = set()
    38→    for cluster in clusters.values():
    39→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
    40→            ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))

    44→def _group_clusterable_issues(
    45→    issues: dict,
    46→    *,
    47→    manual_member_ids: set[str],
    48→) -> tuple[dict[str, list[str]], dict[str, dict]]:
    49→    """Group open, non-suppressed, non-manual issues by detector/subtype key."""
    50→    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    51→    issue_data: dict[str, dict] = {}
    52→    for fid, issue in issues.items():
    53→        if issue.get("status") != "open":
    54→            continue
    55→        if issue.get("suppressed"):
    56→            continue
    57→        if fid in manual_member_ids:
    58→            continue
    59→
    60→        detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    61→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    62→        key = _grouping_key(issue, meta)
    63→        if key is None:
    64→            continue
    65→
    66→        groups[key].append(fid)
    67→        issue_data[fid] = issue
    68→
    69→    groups = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if len(v) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE}
    70→    return groups, issue_data

    74→    plan: dict,

    86→    if new_ids:
    87→        cluster["issue_ids"].extend(new_ids)
    88→        cluster["updated_at"] = now
    89→        changes = 1
    90→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
    91→    for fid in member_ids:
    92→        if fid not in overrides:
    93→            overrides[fid] = {"issue_id": fid, "created_at": now}
    94→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = existing_name
    95→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now

    99→def _sync_auto_cluster(
   100→    plan: dict,
   101→    clusters: dict,
   102→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   103→    *,
   104→    cluster_key: str,
   105→    cluster_name: str,
   106→    member_ids: list[str],
   107→    description: str,
   108→    action: str,
   109→    now: str,
   110→    optional: bool = False,
   111→) -> AutoClusterSyncResult:
   112→    """Create/update one auto-cluster and report the mutation outcome.
   113→
   114→    Mutates:
   115→      - ``clusters`` (cluster create/update),
   116→      - ``existing_by_key`` (cluster-key to name binding),
   117→      - ``plan['overrides']`` (cluster ownership for each member issue).
   118→    """
   119→    changes = 0
   120→    created = False
   121→    existing_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key)
   122→    if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   123→        cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   124→        old_ids = set(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   125→        new_ids_set = set(member_ids)
   126→        if (
   127→            old_ids != new_ids_set
   128→            or cluster.get("description") != description
   129→            or cluster.get("action") != action
   130→        ):
   131→            cluster["issue_ids"] = list(member_ids)
   132→            cluster["description"] = description
   133→            cluster["action"] = action
   134→            cluster["updated_at"] = now

   139→            "description": description,
   140→            "issue_ids": list(member_ids),

   142→            "updated_at": now,
   143→            "auto": True,
   144→            "cluster_key": cluster_key,
   145→            "action": action,
   146→            "user_modified": False,
   147→        }
   148→        if optional:

   150→        clusters[cluster_name] = new_cluster
   151→        existing_by_key[cluster_key] = cluster_name
   152→        changes = 1
   153→        created = True

   155→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
   156→    current_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key, cluster_name)
   157→    for fid in member_ids:

   161→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   162→
   163→    return AutoClusterSyncResult(

   194→
   195→        key_parts = key.split("::")

   197→
   198→        description = _generate_description(members, meta)
   199→        action = _generate_action(meta, subtype)
   200→
   201→        existing_name = existing_by_key.get(key)
   202→        if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   203→            cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   204→            if cluster.get("user_modified"):
   205→                changes += _sync_user_modified_cluster_members(

   208→                    existing_name=existing_name,
   209→                    member_ids=member_ids,
   210→                    now=now,
   211→                )
   212→                continue
   213→
   214→        if cluster_name in clusters and clusters[cluster_name].get("cluster_key") != key:
   215→            cluster_name = f"{cluster_name}-{len(member_ids)}"
   216→
   217→        sync_result = _sync_auto_cluster(

   228→        changes += int(sync_result.changed)

1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions`` and ``auto_cluster``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.base.config import DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE
    13→from desloppify.base.enums import Status

    17→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    18→from desloppify.engine.planning.helpers import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    19→
    20→# Detectors whose issues are NOT objective mechanical work.

    22→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    23→})
    24→
    25→
    26→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    27→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    28→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    29→
    30→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any planned open non-subjective issues?
    31→    objective_count: int  # how many (planned only, post-triage)
    32→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    33→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    34→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    35→
    36→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    37→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    38→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    39→            return True  # unconditional
    40→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    41→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    42→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    43→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    44→        return False
    45→
    46→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    47→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    48→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    49→            return False  # never evict unscored
    50→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    51→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    52→        return False
    53→
    54→    @property
    55→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    56→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    57→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    58→
    59→
    60→def _is_evidence_only(issue: dict) -> bool:
    61→    """Return True if the issue is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    62→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    63→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    64→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    65→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    66→        issue_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(issue.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    67→        if issue_rank > threshold_rank:
    68→            return True
    69→    return False
    70→
    71→
    72→class _ScanPathFromStatePolicy:
    73→    """Sentinel type: resolve scan_path from state."""
    74→
    75→
    76→_SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY = _ScanPathFromStatePolicy()
    77→ScanPathPolicyOption = str | None | _ScanPathFromStatePolicy
    78→
    79→
    80→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    81→    state: StateModel,
    82→    *,
    83→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    84→    scan_path: ScanPathPolicyOption = _SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY,
    85→    plan: dict | None = None,
    86→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    87→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    88→
    89→    *scan_path* defaults to ``state["scan_path"]`` so callers don't need to
    90→    thread it manually.  Pass an explicit ``str`` to override, or ``None``
    91→    to disable scope filtering.  When *plan* is set, issues whose IDs
    92→    appear in ``plan["skipped"]`` are excluded.
    93→
    94→    Imports policy helpers from ``stale_policy`` so this module remains
    95→    side-effect free and cycle-safe.
    96→    """
    97→    from desloppify.engine._plan.policy.stale import (
    98→        current_stale_ids,
    99→        current_under_target_ids,
   100→        current_unscored_ids,
   101→    )
   102→
   103→    resolved_scan_path: str | None = (
   104→        state.get("scan_path")
   105→        if isinstance(scan_path, _ScanPathFromStatePolicy)
   106→        else scan_path
   107→    )
   108→
   109→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   110→    skipped_ids = set((plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   111→
   112→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective issues.
   113→    # Evidence-only issues (below standalone confidence threshold) are
   114→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   115→    # Issues outside scan_path and plan-skipped issues are also excluded
   116→    # so the policy matches what the user actually sees in the queue.
   117→    objective_issue_ids = [
   118→        issue_id
   119→        for issue_id, issue in issues.items()
   120→        if issue.get("status") == Status.OPEN
   121→        and issue.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   122→        and not issue.get("suppressed")
   123→        and not _is_evidence_only(issue)
   124→        and issue_in_scan_scope(str(issue.get("file", "")), resolved_scan_path)
   125→        and issue_id not in skipped_ids
   126→    ]
   127→
   128→    # Only explicitly queued objectives count — backlog items don't block
   129→    # subjective reruns.
   130→    objective_count = len(_executable_objective_ids(set(objective_issue_ids), plan))
   131→
   132→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   133→    stale = current_stale_ids(state)
   134→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   135→
   136→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   137→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   138→        objective_count=objective_count,
   139→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   140→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),
   141→        under_target_ids=frozenset(under_target),
   142→    )
   143→
   144→
   145→__all__ = [
   146→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   147→    "SubjectiveVisibility",
   148→    "compute_subjective_visibility",
   149→]

    68→def _option_value(options: object | None, name: str, default: Any) -> Any:
    69→    if options is None:
    70→        return default
    71→    return getattr(options, name, default)
    72→
    73→
    74→def _resolved_scan_path(options: object | None, state: StateModel) -> str | None:
    75→    scan_path = _option_value(options, "scan_path", state.get("scan_path"))
    76→    if hasattr(scan_path, "__class__") and scan_path.__class__.__name__ == "_ScanPathFromState":
    77→        return state.get("scan_path")
    78→    return scan_path
    79→
    80→
    81→def _is_fresh_boundary(plan: dict | None) -> bool:
    82→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
    83→        return True
    84→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores")
    85→    if not scores:
    86→        return True
    87→    return isinstance(scores, dict) and bool(scores.get("reset"))
    88→
    89→
    90→def _is_objective_item(item: WorkQueueItem, *, skipped_ids: set[str]) -> bool:
    91→    return (
    92→        item.get("kind") in {"issue", "cluster"}
    93→        and item.get("detector", "") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
    94→        and item.get("id", "") not in skipped_ids
    95→    )
    96→
    97→
    98→def _review_issue_items(items: Iterable[WorkQueueItem]) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
    99→    return [
   100→        item for item in items
   101→        if item.get("detector", "") in {"review", "concerns", "subjective_review"}
   102→    ]
   103→
   104→
   105→def _auto_promoted_autofix_ids(plan: dict | None) -> set[str]:
   106→    """Return auto-cluster member IDs eligible to execute without manual promotion."""
   107→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   108→        return set()
   109→    autofix_ids: set[str] = set()
   110→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   111→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   112→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict) or not cluster.get("auto"):
   113→            continue
   114→        action = str(cluster.get("action", ""))
   115→        if "desloppify autofix" not in action:
   116→            continue
   117→        for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
   118→            if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id and issue_id not in skipped_ids:
   119→                autofix_ids.add(issue_id)
   120→    return autofix_ids
   121→
   122→
   123→def _executable_review_issue_items(
   124→    plan: dict | None,
   125→    state: StateModel,
   126→    review_issue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   127→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   128→    """Hide raw review findings until triage is current for the live issue set."""
   129→    if not review_issue_items or not isinstance(plan, dict):
   130→        return review_issue_items
   131→
   132→    triage_snapshot = build_triage_snapshot(plan, state)
   133→    if triage_snapshot.has_triage_in_queue:
   134→        return []
   135→    if triage_snapshot.is_triage_stale:
   136→        return []
   137→    if not triage_snapshot.triage_has_run:
   138→        return []
   139→    return review_issue_items
   140→
   141→
   142→def _subjective_partitions(
   143→    state: StateModel,
   144→    *,
   145→    scoped_issues: dict[str, dict],
   146→    threshold: float,
   147→) -> tuple[list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   148→    candidates = build_subjective_items(state, scoped_issues, threshold=threshold)
   149→    initial = [item for item in candidates if item.get("initial_review")]
   150→    postflight = [item for item in candidates if not item.get("initial_review")]
   151→    return initial, postflight
   152→
   153→
   154→def _workflow_partitions(
   155→    plan: dict | None,
   156→    state: StateModel,
   157→) -> tuple[list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   158→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   159→        return [], [], []
   160→    scan_items = [
   161→        item
   162→        for item in (
   163→            build_deferred_disposition_item(plan),
   164→            build_run_scan_item(plan),
   165→        )
   166→        if item is not None
   167→    ]
   168→    postflight_workflow = [
   169→        item
   170→        for item in (
   171→            build_score_checkpoint_item(plan, state),
   172→            build_import_scores_item(plan, state),
   173→            build_communicate_score_item(plan, state),
   174→            build_create_plan_item(plan),
   175→        )
   176→        if item is not None
   177→    ]
   178→    triage_items = build_triage_stage_items(plan, state)
   179→    return scan_items, postflight_workflow, triage_items
   180→
   181→
   182→def _phase_for_snapshot(
   183→    *,
   184→    fresh_boundary: bool,
   185→    initial_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   186→    explicit_queue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   187→    scan_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   188→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   189→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   190→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   191→) -> str:
   192→    if fresh_boundary and initial_review_items:
   193→        return PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL
   194→    if explicit_queue_items:
   195→        return PHASE_EXECUTE
   196→    if scan_items:
   197→        return PHASE_SCAN
   198→    if postflight_review_items:
   199→        return PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT
   200→    if postflight_workflow_items:
   201→        return PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT
   202→    if triage_items:
   203→        return PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT
   204→    return PHASE_SCAN
   205→
   206→
   207→def _execution_items_for_phase(
   208→    phase: str,
   209→    *,
   210→    explicit_queue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   211→    initial_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   212→    scan_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   213→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   214→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   215→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   216→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   217→    if phase == PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL:
   218→        return initial_review_items
   219→    if phase == PHASE_EXECUTE:
   220→        return explicit_queue_items
   221→    if phase == PHASE_SCAN:
   222→        deferred_items = [
   223→            item for item in scan_items
   224→            if item.get("id") == WORKFLOW_DEFERRED_DISPOSITION_ID
   225→        ]
   226→        if deferred_items:
   227→            return deferred_items
   228→        return [
   229→            item for item in scan_items
   230→            if item.get("id") == WORKFLOW_RUN_SCAN_ID
   231→        ]
   232→    if phase == PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT:
   233→        return postflight_review_items
   234→    if phase == PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT:
   235→        return postflight_workflow_items
   236→    if phase == PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT:
   237→        return triage_items
   238→    return []
   239→
   240→
   241→def build_queue_snapshot(
   242→    state: StateModel,
   243→    *,
   244→    options: object | None = None,
   245→    plan: dict | None = None,
   246→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
   247→) -> QueueSnapshot:
   248→    """Build the canonical queue snapshot for the current state."""
   249→    context = _option_value(options, "context", None)
   250→    effective_plan = context.plan if context is not None else (
   251→        plan if plan is not None else _option_value(options, "plan", None)
   252→    )
   253→    scan_path = _resolved_scan_path(options, state)
   254→    skipped_ids = set((effective_plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   255→    scoped_issues = path_scoped_issues(state.get("issues", {}), scan_path)
   256→    scope = _option_value(options, "scope", None)
   257→    chronic = bool(_option_value(options, "chronic", False))
   258→
   259→    all_issue_items = build_issue_items(
   260→        state,
   261→        scan_path=scan_path,
   262→        status_filter="open",
   263→        scope=scope,
   264→        chronic=chronic,
   265→    )
   266→    objective_items = [
   267→        item for item in all_issue_items
   268→        if _is_objective_item(item, skipped_ids=skipped_ids)
   269→    ]
   270→    executable_objective_ids = _executable_objective_ids(
   271→        {item.get("id", "") for item in objective_items},
   272→        effective_plan,
   273→    )
   274→    explicit_objective_items = [
   275→        item for item in objective_items
   276→        if item.get("id", "") in executable_objective_ids
   277→    ]
   278→    review_issue_items = _review_issue_items(all_issue_items)
   279→    executable_review_items = _executable_review_issue_items(
   280→        effective_plan,
   281→        state,
   282→        review_issue_items,
   283→    )
   284→    review_issue_ids = {item.get("id", "") for item in review_issue_items}
   285→    executable_review_ids = {item.get("id", "") for item in executable_review_items}
   286→    explicit_queue_ids = {
   287→        str(issue_id)
   288→        for issue_id in (effective_plan or {}).get("queue_order", [])
   289→        if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id
   290→    } - skipped_ids
   291→    explicit_queue_ids |= _auto_promoted_autofix_ids(effective_plan)
   292→    explicit_queue_items = [
   293→        item for item in all_issue_items
   294→        if item.get("id", "") in explicit_queue_ids
   295→        and (
   296→            item.get("id", "") not in review_issue_ids
   297→            or item.get("id", "") in executable_review_ids
   298→        )
   299→    ]
   300→    initial_review_items, subjective_postflight_items = _subjective_partitions(
   301→        state,
   302→        scoped_issues=scoped_issues,
   303→        threshold=target_strict,
   304→    )
   305→    postflight_review_items = [*subjective_postflight_items, *executable_review_items]
   306→    scan_items, postflight_workflow_items, triage_items = _workflow_partitions(
   307→        effective_plan,
   308→        state,
   309→    )
   310→
   311→    fresh_boundary = _is_fresh_boundary(effective_plan)
   312→    phase = _phase_for_snapshot(
   313→        fresh_boundary=fresh_boundary,
   314→        initial_review_items=initial_review_items,
   315→        explicit_queue_items=explicit_queue_items,
   316→        scan_items=scan_items,
   317→        postflight_review_items=postflight_review_items,
   318→        postflight_workflow_items=postflight_workflow_items,
   319→        triage_items=triage_items,
   320→    )
   321→    execution_items = _execution_items_for_phase(
   322→        phase,
   323→        explicit_queue_items=explicit_queue_items,
   324→        initial_review_items=initial_review_items,
   325→        scan_items=scan_items,
   326→        postflight_review_items=postflight_review_items,
   327→        postflight_workflow_items=postflight_workflow_items,
   328→        triage_items=triage_items,
   329→    )
   330→
   331→    execution_ids = {item.get("id", "") for item in execution_items}
   332→    backlog_items = [
   333→        item for item in (
   334→            [
   335→                *objective_items,
   336→                *initial_review_items,
   337→                *subjective_postflight_items,
   338→                *review_issue_items,
   339→                *scan_items,
   340→                *postflight_workflow_items,
   341→                *triage_items,
   342→            ]
   343→        )
   344→        if item.get("id", "") not in execution_ids
   345→    ]
   346→    objective_backlog_count = sum(
   347→        1 for item in objective_items if item.get("id", "") not in execution_ids
   348→    )
   349→    has_unplanned_objective_blockers = len(explicit_objective_items) < len(objective_items)
   350→
   351→    return QueueSnapshot(
   352→        phase=phase,
   353→        all_objective_items=tuple(objective_items),
   354→        all_initial_review_items=tuple(initial_review_items),
   355→        all_postflight_review_items=tuple(postflight_review_items),
   356→        all_scan_items=tuple(scan_items),
   357→        all_postflight_workflow_items=tuple(postflight_workflow_items),
   358→        all_postflight_triage_items=tuple(triage_items),
   359→        execution_items=tuple(execution_items),
   360→        backlog_items=tuple(backlog_items),
   361→        objective_in_scope_count=len(objective_items),
   362→        planned_objective_count=len(explicit_objective_items),
   363→        objective_execution_count=sum(
   364→            1
   365→            for item in execution_items
   366→            if item.get("kind") in {"issue", "cluster"}
   367→            and item.get("detector", "") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   368→        ),
   369→        objective_backlog_count=objective_backlog_count,
   370→        subjective_initial_count=len(initial_review_items),
   371→        subjective_postflight_count=len(postflight_review_items),
   372→        workflow_postflight_count=len(postflight_workflow_items),
   373→        triage_pending_count=len(triage_items),
   374→        has_unplanned_objective_blockers=has_unplanned_objective_blockers,
   375→    )
   376→
   377→
   378→def coarse_phase_name(phase: str) -> str:
   379→    """Map internal queue phases to the persisted coarse lifecycle value."""
   380→    if phase == PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL or phase == PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT:
   381→        return "review"
   382→    if phase == PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT:
   383→        return "workflow"
   384→    if phase == PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT:
   385→        return "triage"
   386→    return phase
   387→
   388→
   389→__all__ = [
   390→    "PHASE_EXECUTE",
   391→    "PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL",
   392→    "PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT",
   393→    "PHASE_SCAN",
   394→    "PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT",
   395→    "PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT",
   396→    "QueueSnapshot",
   397→    "build_queue_snapshot",
   398→    "coarse_phase_name",
   399→]
   400→

   142→    for dimension in sorted(set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim)):
   143→        recurring[dimension] = {

   210→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   211→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Produce a coherent
   212→prioritized strategy for all open review issues, and decide which mechanical
   213→backlog items should be promoted into the active queue now.
   214→
   215→Your plan should:

   217→- Give each cluster a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   218→- Order clusters by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   219→- Dismiss issues that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   220→- Mark which clusters are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   221→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   222→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all issues coherently
   223→
   224→Available directions for clusters: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   225→
   226→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   227→- `desloppify plan queue` — view the explicit execution queue in priority order
   228→- `desloppify backlog` — inspect broader open work outside the execution queue
   229→- `desloppify plan promote <id-or-pattern>` — move backlog work into the active queue
   230→- `desloppify plan focus <name>` — focus the queue on one cluster
   231→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   232→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   233→- `desloppify plan resolve <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   234→- `desloppify plan reorder <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   235→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   236→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   237→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review issues
   238→
   239→Your output defines the active work plan for review findings and any explicitly
   240→promoted backlog work. Mechanical backlog items you do not mention remain in
   241→backlog by default. Dismissed issues will be removed from the queue with your
   242→stated reason.
   243→
   244→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   245→{
   246→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   247→  "clusters": [
   248→    {
   249→      "name": "slug-name",
   250→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   251→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   252→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   253→      "issue_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   254→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   255→      "agent_safe": true,
   256→      "dependency_order": 1,
   257→      "action_steps": [
   258→        {
   259→          "title": "Short imperative step title",
   260→          "detail": "Concrete implementation detail with file paths/locations",
   261→          "issue_refs": ["id1"]
   262→        }
   263→      ],
   264→      "status": "pending"
   265→    }
   266→  ],
   267→  "dismissed_issues": [
   268→    {"issue_id": "id", "reason": "why this issue doesn't make sense"}
   269→  ],
   270→  "contradiction_notes": [
   271→    {"kept": "issue_id", "dismissed": "issue_id", "reason": "why"}
   272→  ],
   273→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   274→}
   275→"""
   276→
   277→def _append_existing_clusters_section(parts: list[str], clusters: dict[str, Cluster]) -> None:
   278→    if not clusters:
   279→        return
   280→    parts.append("## Existing clusters")
   281→    for name, cluster in sorted(clusters.items()):
   282→        status = cluster.get("status", "pending")
   283→        thesis = cluster.get("thesis", "")
   284→        direction = cluster.get("direction", "")
   285→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   286→        parts.append(
   287→            f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   288→            f"\n  Issues: {', '.join(issue_ids[:10])}"
   289→            f"{'...' if len(issue_ids) > 10 else ''}"
   290→        )
   291→    parts.append("")
   292→
   293→
   294→def _append_changed_issue_section(
   295→    parts: list[str],
   296→    *,
   297→    title: str,
   298→    issue_ids: set[str],
   299→    issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
   300→) -> None:
   301→    if not issue_ids:
   302→        return
   303→    parts.append(f"## {title} ({len(issue_ids)})")
   304→    for issue_id in sorted(issue_ids):
   305→        if issues is None:
   306→            parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   307→            continue
   308→        issue = issues.get(issue_id, {})
   309→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}: {issue.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   310→    parts.append("")
   311→
   312→
   313→def _append_resolved_issue_context(parts: list[str], resolved_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   314→    if not resolved_issues:
   315→        return
   316→    parts.append(
   317→        "## Resolved review issues available for recurrence context "
   318→        f"({len(resolved_issues)})"
   319→    )
   320→    resolved_ids = sorted(resolved_issues)
   321→    for issue_id in resolved_ids[:30]:
   322→        issue = resolved_issues.get(issue_id, {})
   323→        summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   324→        dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   325→        dim_suffix = f" [{dimension}]" if dimension else ""
   326→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}{dim_suffix}: {summary}")
   327→    if len(resolved_ids) > 30:
   328→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(resolved_ids) - 30} more resolved issues")
   329→    parts.append("")
   330→
   331→
   332→def _append_completed_clusters_section(parts: list[str], completed_clusters: list[dict]) -> None:
   333→    if not completed_clusters:
   334→        return
   335→    parts.append(
   336→        "## Completed clusters since last triage "
   337→        f"({len(completed_clusters)})"
   338→    )
   339→    completed = sorted(
   340→        completed_clusters,
   341→        key=lambda cluster: str(cluster.get("completed_at", "")),
   342→        reverse=True,
   343→    )
   344→    for cluster in completed[:10]:
   345→        name = str(cluster.get("name", "(unnamed cluster)"))
   346→        thesis = str(cluster.get("thesis") or cluster.get("description") or "")
   347→        completed_at = str(cluster.get("completed_at", ""))
   348→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   349→        issue_count = len(issue_ids) if isinstance(issue_ids, list) else 0
   350→        parts.append(
   351→            f"- {name}: {thesis} (issues: {issue_count}, completed_at: {completed_at})"
   352→        )
   353→    if len(completed) > 10:
   354→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(completed) - 10} more completed clusters")
   355→    parts.append("")
   356→
   357→
   358→def _append_recurring_dimensions_section(
   359→    parts: list[str],
   360→    review_issues: dict[str, dict],
   361→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
   362→) -> None:
   363→    recurring = _recurring_dimensions(review_issues, resolved_issues)
   364→    if not recurring:
   365→        return
   366→    parts.append(
   367→        "## Potential recurring dimensions (resolved issues still have open peers)"
   368→    )
   369→    for dimension, bucket in recurring.items():
   370→        open_count = len(bucket["open"])
   371→        resolved_count = len(bucket["resolved"])
   372→        parts.append(
   373→            f"- {dimension}: {open_count} open / {resolved_count} recently resolved"
   374→        )
   375→    parts.append("")
   376→
   377→
   378→def _append_open_review_issues_section(parts: list[str], review_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   379→    parts.append(f"## All open review issues ({len(review_issues)})")
   380→    for issue_id, issue in sorted(review_issues.items()):
   381→        detail = issue.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(issue.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   382→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   383→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   384→        confidence = issue.get("confidence", "medium")
   385→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
   386→        summary = issue.get("summary", "")
   387→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id}")
   388→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   389→        if dimension:
   390→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   391→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   392→        if suggestion:
   393→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   394→    parts.append("")
   395→
   396→
   397→def _append_dimension_scores_section(parts: list[str], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   398→    if not dimension_scores:
   399→        return
   400→    parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   401→    for name, data in sorted(dimension_scores.items()):
   402→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   403→            continue
   404→        score = data.get("score", "?")
   405→        strict = data.get("strict", score)
   406→        issues = data.get("failing", 0)
   407→        parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   408→    parts.append("")
   409→
   410→
   411→def _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   412→    parts: list[str],
   413→    objective_backlog_issues: dict[str, dict],
   414→) -> None:
   415→    if not objective_backlog_issues:
   416→        return
   417→    parts.append(
   418→        "## Mechanical backlog context "
   419→        f"({len(objective_backlog_issues)} open detector-created items)"
   420→    )
   421→    parts.append(
   422→        "These items are backlog by default. Promote only the ones that should become active queue work now."
   423→    )
   424→    parts.append(
   425→        "If you do not mention a mechanical backlog item in your strategy, it stays in backlog."
   426→    )
   427→
   428→    by_detector: dict[str, int] = {}
   429→    for issue in objective_backlog_issues.values():
   430→        detector = str(issue.get("detector", "unknown"))
   431→        by_detector[detector] = by_detector.get(detector, 0) + 1
   432→
   433→    if by_detector:
   434→        parts.append("### Detector summary")
   435→        for detector, count in sorted(by_detector.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0])):
   436→            parts.append(f"- {detector}: {count}")
   437→
   438→    parts.append("### Sample backlog items")
   439→    sample_ids = sorted(objective_backlog_issues)[:20]
   440→    for issue_id in sample_ids:
   441→        issue = objective_backlog_issues.get(issue_id, {})
   442→        file_path = str(issue.get("file", ""))
   443→        summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   444→        detector = str(issue.get("detector", "unknown"))
   445→        parts.append(f"- [{detector}] {issue_id}")
   446→        if file_path:
   447→            parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   448→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   449→    if len(objective_backlog_issues) > len(sample_ids):
   450→        parts.append(
   451→            f"- ... and {len(objective_backlog_issues) - len(sample_ids)} more backlog items"
   452→        )
   453→    parts.append("")
   454→
   455→
   456→def _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts: list[str], dismissed_ids: list[str]) -> None:
   457→    if not dismissed_ids:
   458→        return
   459→    parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(dismissed_ids)})")
   460→    parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   461→    for issue_id in dismissed_ids:
   462→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   463→    parts.append("")
   464→
   465→
   466→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   467→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   468→    parts: list[str] = []
   469→    _append_existing_clusters_section(parts, si.existing_clusters)
   470→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   471→        parts,
   472→        title="New issues since last triage",
   473→        issue_ids=si.new_since_last,
   474→        issues=si.review_issues,
   475→    )
   476→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   477→        parts,
   478→        title="Resolved since last triage",
   479→        issue_ids=si.resolved_since_last,
   480→    )
   481→    _append_resolved_issue_context(parts, si.resolved_issues)
   482→    _append_completed_clusters_section(parts, si.completed_clusters)
   483→    _append_recurring_dimensions_section(parts, si.review_issues, si.resolved_issues)
   484→    _append_open_review_issues_section(parts, si.review_issues)
   485→    _append_dimension_scores_section(parts, si.dimension_scores)
   486→    _append_mechanical_backlog_section(parts, si.objective_backlog_issues)
   487→    _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts, si.previously_dismissed)
   488→    return "\n".join(parts)
   489→
   490→__all__ = [
   491→    "_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
   492→    "ContradictionNote",
   493→    "DismissedIssue",
   494→    "TriageInput",
   495→    "TriageResult",
   496→    "build_triage_prompt",
   497→    "collect_triage_input",
   498→]
   499→

   180→def preflight_stage(
   181→    *,
   182→    stage: str,
   183→    prompt_mode: PromptMode = "output_only",
   184→    plan: Mapping[str, Any],
   185→    triage_input: Any,

   191→    ],
   192→) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
   193→    """Fail fast when a requested stage has invalid upstream prerequisites."""
   194→    # Dry-run previews do not persist upstream stage reports, so preflight checks that
   195→    # require recorded reflect/enrich state would otherwise fail by construction.
   196→    if dry_run and stage in {"organize", "sense-check"}:
   197→        return True, None
   198→

   201→        progress = compute_triage_progress(stages)
   202→        if "sense-check" in stages or progress.current_stage == "sense-check":
   203→            return True, None
   204→        reason = "enrich_not_confirmed"
   205→        append_run_log(f"stage-preflight-failed stage={stage} reason={reason}")
   206→        return False, reason
   207→
   208→    if stage != "organize":
   209→        return True, None
   210→    stages = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {})
   211→    reflect_report = str(stages.get("reflect", {}).get("report", ""))

   213→        report=reflect_report,

   216→        ),

   218→    if not accounting_ok:

   220→        if missing_ids:

   222→        if duplicate_ids:
   223→            reason_parts.append(f"duplicates={len(duplicate_ids)}")
   224→        reason = "reflect_accounting_invalid"
   225→        if reason_parts:
   226→            reason = f"{reason}({' '.join(reason_parts)})"
   227→        append_run_log(f"stage-preflight-failed stage={stage} reason={reason}")
   228→        return False, reason

   251→def build_reflect_repair_prompt(
   252→    *,
   253→    triage_input: Any,
   254→    prior_reports: Mapping[str, str],
   255→    repo_root: Path,
   256→    cli_command: str,
   257→    original_report: str,

   259→    duplicate_ids: list[str],
   260→    build_stage_prompt_fn: Callable[..., str],
   261→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   262→) -> str:
   263→    """Build a targeted retry prompt for a reflect report that failed accounting."""
   264→    missing_short = ", ".join(issue_id.rsplit("::", 1)[-1] for issue_id in missing_ids) or "none"
   265→    duplicate_short = (
   266→        ", ".join(issue_id.rsplit("::", 1)[-1] for issue_id in duplicate_ids) or "none"
   267→    )
   268→    base_prompt = build_stage_prompt_fn(
   269→        "reflect",
   270→        triage_input,
   271→        dict(prior_reports),
   272→        repo_root=repo_root,
   273→        mode="output_only",
   274→        cli_command=cli_command,
   275→        stages_data=stages_data,
   276→    )
   277→    return "\n\n".join(
   278→        [
   279→            base_prompt,
   280→            "## Repair Pass",
   281→            "Your previous reflect report failed the exact-hash accounting check.",
   282→            f"Missing hashes: {missing_short}",
   283→            f"Duplicated hashes: {duplicate_short}",
   284→            "Rewrite the FULL reflect report so it passes validation.",
   285→            "Requirements for this repair:",
   286→            "- Start with a `## Coverage Ledger` section.",
   287→            '- Use one ledger line per issue hash: `- abcd1234 -> cluster "name"` or `- abcd1234 -> skip "reason"`.',
   288→            "- Mention every required hash exactly once in that ledger.",
   289→            "- Do not mention hashes anywhere else in the report.",
   290→            "- Preserve the same strategy unless fixing the missing/duplicate hashes forces a small adjustment.",
   291→            "- Output only the corrected reflect report.",
   292→            "## Previous Reflect Report",
   293→            original_report,
   294→        ]
   295→    )
   296→
   297→
   298→def repair_reflect_report_if_needed(
   299→    *,
   300→    report: str,
   301→    triage_input: Any,
   302→    prior_reports: Mapping[str, str],

   310→    dependencies: StageExecutionDependencies,
   311→    stages_data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   312→) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
   313→    """Retry reflect once with a targeted repair prompt when accounting is invalid."""
   314→    _cited, missing_ids, duplicate_ids = dependencies.analyze_reflect_issue_accounting(
   315→        report=report,
   316→        valid_ids=set(
   317→            getattr(triage_input, "review_issues", getattr(triage_input, "open_issues", {})).keys()
   318→        ),
   319→    )
   320→    if not missing_ids and not duplicate_ids:
   321→        return report, None
   322→
   323→    print(colorize("  Reflect: repairing missing/duplicate hash accounting...", "yellow"))
   324→    append_run_log(
   325→        "stage-reflect-repair-start "
   326→        f"missing={len(missing_ids)} duplicates={len(duplicate_ids)}"
   327→    )
   328→
   329→    repair_prompt = build_reflect_repair_prompt(

     5→from desloppify.base.registry import DetectorMeta
     6→from desloppify.engine._plan.constants import AUTO_PREFIX
     7→
     8→
     9→def grouping_key(issue: dict, meta: DetectorMeta | None) -> str | None:
    10→    """Compute a deterministic grouping key for a issue.
    11→
    12→    Returns ``None`` for judgment-required detectors — these flow through the
    13→    review process as mechanical evidence rather than becoming auto-tasks.
    14→    """
    15→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    16→
    17→    if meta is None:
    18→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    19→
    20→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
    21→        detail = issue.get("detail") or {}
    22→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
    23→        if dimension:
    24→            return f"review::{dimension}"
    25→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    26→
    27→    if meta.needs_judgment:
    28→        return None
    29→
    30→    if meta.action_type == "auto_fix":
    31→        return f"auto::{detector}"
    32→
    33→    return f"detector::{detector}"
    34→
    35→
    36→def cluster_name_from_key(key: str) -> str:
    37→    """Convert a grouping key to an ``auto/...`` cluster name."""
    38→    parts = key.split("::")
    39→    if len(parts) == 2:
    40→        prefix_type = parts[0]
    41→        if prefix_type == "review":
    42→            return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}review-{parts[1]}"
    43→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}"
    44→    if len(parts) == 3:
    45→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}"
    46→    return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{key.replace('::', '-')}"

    49→def generate_description(

    53→    """Generate a human-readable cluster description."""
    54→    count = len(members)

    56→

    58→        detail = (members[0].get("detail") or {}) if members else {}
    59→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", detector)
    60→        return f"Address {count} {dimension} review issues"

   106→        matched_fixer = subtype_has_fixer(meta, subtype)
   107→        if matched_fixer:
   108→            return f"desloppify autofix {matched_fixer} --dry-run"
   109→    elif meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers:
   110→        return f"desloppify autofix {meta.fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   111→
   112→    if meta.tool == "move":
   113→        return "desloppify move"
   114→
   115→    if meta.guidance:
   116→        if subtype:
   117→            return strip_guidance_examples(meta.guidance)
   118→        return meta.guidance
   119→
   120→    return _ACTION_TYPE_TEMPLATES.get(meta.action_type, "review and fix each issue")
   121→
   122→

   125→    "generate_action",

   373→def _execute_parallel_stage(
   374→    *,
   375→    context: StageRunContext,
   376→    stage: str,
   377→    handler: StageHandler | None,
   378→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   379→    """Execute optional parallel stage path."""

   382→
   383→    parallel_result = handler.run_parallel(context)
   384→    if parallel_result.status == "dry_run":
   385→        return StageExecutionResult(
   386→            status="dry_run",
   387→            payload={"status": "dry_run"},
   388→            used_parallel=True,
   389→        )
   390→
   391→    if parallel_result.ok and parallel_result.merged_output:
   392→        if handler.record_report is not None:
   393→            handler.record_report(parallel_result.merged_output, context.args, context.services)
   394→            return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={}, used_parallel=True)
   395→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   396→
   397→    if parallel_result.ok:
   398→        return StageExecutionResult(status="ready", payload={})
   399→
   400→    elapsed = int(time.monotonic() - context.stage_start)
   401→    error_reason = parallel_result.reason or "parallel_execution_failed"
   402→    print(colorize(f"  {stage.capitalize()}: parallel execution failed. Aborting.", "red"))
   403→    context.append_run_log(
   404→        f"stage-failed stage={stage} elapsed={elapsed}s reason={error_reason}"
   405→    )
   406→    return StageExecutionResult(
   407→        status="failed",
   408→        payload={
   409→            "status": "failed",
   410→            "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
   411→            "error": error_reason,
   412→        },
   413→        used_parallel=True,
   414→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,

   416→
   417→
   418→def _failure_result(
   419→    *,
   420→    stage: str,
   421→    elapsed: int | None,
   422→    error: str,
   423→    append_run_log: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
   424→    log_event: str = "stage-failed",
   425→    log_reason: str | None = None,
   426→    printed_message: str | None = None,
   427→) -> StageExecutionResult:
   428→    if printed_message is not None:
   429→        print(colorize(printed_message, "red"))
   430→    if append_run_log is not None:
   431→        log_parts = [f"{log_event} stage={stage}"]
   432→        if elapsed is not None:

   434→        log_parts.append(f"reason={log_reason or error}")
   435→        append_run_log(" ".join(log_parts))
   436→    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
   437→        "status": "failed",
   438→        "error": error,
   439→    }
   440→    if elapsed is not None:

   442→    return StageExecutionResult(
   443→        status="failed",
   444→        payload=payload,
   445→        elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
   446→    )

   213→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})

   226→    queue_total = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0

   229→    strict_score = score_snapshot(state).strict

   236→        return

   238→    potentials = _merge_potentials_safe(state.get("potentials", {}))
   239→    next_render_mod.render_terminal_items(

   273→    if not show_plan_context:
   274→        return None
   275→    if plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("overrides") or plan.get("clusters"):
   276→        return plan
   277→    return None
